weeks.title: Forces, moments and equivalent systems
weeks.summary: Is week aap force ko vector ki tarah todna-jodna, moment aur couple nikalna, aur kisi bhi force system ko ek simple equivalent system me badalna seekhoge.
concepts: **Force ek vector hai**: iska magnitude, direction aur point of application teeno matter karte hain. Agar force F, +x axis se θ angle par hai to components Fx = F cosθ aur Fy = F sinθ. Angle kis axis se naapa gaya hai, ye hamesha check karo.
**Resultant**: kai forces ka resultant R = ΣF, yaani components alag-alag jodo: Rx = ΣFx, Ry = ΣFy. Phir |R| = √(Rx² + Ry²) aur direction tan⁻¹(Ry/Rx), quadrant signs dekh kar.

**Moment of a force** kisi point O ke about rotation ki tendency hai: M = F·d, jahan d = O se force ki line of action tak perpendicular distance. 2D me components se M_O = x·Fy − y·Fx. Is course me counter-clockwise (CCW) moment positive lenge.
**Varignon's theorem**: kisi force ka moment = uske components ke moments ka sum. Isliye perpendicular distance nikalna mushkil ho to force ko components me tod kar har component ka moment le lo.
**Couple**: do barabar, opposite, parallel forces jo distance d par hon. Net force zero, par moment C = F·d. Couple ka moment har point ke about same hota hai, isliye ise 'free vector' kehte hain.

**Force-couple system**: kisi force F ko point A se point B par shift karna ho to B par wahi F lagao aur saath me ek couple jodo jiska moment = F ka B ke about moment. Rigid body par effect bilkul same rehta hai.

**Single resultant tak reduce karna**: pehle kisi point O par R = ΣF aur M_O = ΣM nikalo. Phir R ko aisi jagah rakho jahan R ka O ke about moment = M_O. Parallel vertical forces ke liye location x = M_O / R (signs ke saath).
**3D me moment**: M_O = r × F, jahan r = O se force ke kisi bhi point tak position vector. Kisi axis ke about moment = λ · (r × F), jahan λ us axis ka unit vector hai.

example.problem: Ek 4 m lambi horizontal beam AB hai, A par x = 0. Uspar teen vertical forces hain: x = 1 m par 10 kN neeche, x = 3 m par 20 kN neeche, aur x = 4 m (end B) par 6 kN upar. Is system ka single resultant aur A se uski location nikalo. (Upar positive, CCW moment positive.)
steps: Resultant: R = −10 − 20 + 6 = −24 kN, yaani 24 kN neeche.
A ke about moments (M = x·Fy): 1·(−10) + 3·(−20) + 4·(+6) = −10 − 60 + 24 = −46 kN·m, yaani 46 kN·m clockwise.
Ab 24 kN neeche wali single force ko A se distance x par rakho. Uska A ke about moment = x·(−24).
Equivalent hone ke liye −24x = −46, to x = 46/24 = 1.917 m.
Check: 1.917 m 1 m aur 3 m ke beech hai, jo sense banata hai kyunki bade downward forces wahin hain.
Answer: **24 kN neeche, A se 1.92 m door**.

mistakes: Moment me poori distance (A se force ke point tak) le lena, chahe force us line ke along ho. Hamesha perpendicular distance lo, ya M = x·Fy − y·Fx use karo.
Couple ko kisi point par shift karte waqt uska moment badal dena. Couple ka moment har point ke about same rehta hai; sirf force ko shift karne par naya couple aata hai.
Do forces ka resultant scalar jod kar nikalna (100 + 60 = 160). Components me tod kar vector sum lo.
revision: Fx = F cosθ, Fy = F sinθ (θ = +x axis se angle).
M_O = F·d⊥ = x·Fy − y·Fx, CCW positive.
Couple moment = F·d, har point ke about same.
Force shift karo to couple jodo: M = r × F.
Parallel forces ka resultant location: x = M_O / R.

questions.question: 50 N ki force +x axis se 30° upar (anticlockwise) direction me lagi hai. Iske x aur y components kya hain?
questions.explanation: Fx = 50 cos30° = 43.3 N aur Fy = 50 sin30° = 25.0 N. Sabse common trap sin aur cos ko swap kar dena hai (25.0, 43.3), jo tab sahi hota jab angle y-axis se naapa gaya hota. 57.7 N, 50 ko cos30° se divide karne se aata hai.

questions.question: Ek plate par ek couple laga hai: do 40 N ki parallel, opposite forces jinki lines of action ke beech 0.25 m ka gap hai. Plate par ek point P hai jo is couple se 2 m door hai. P ke about couple ka moment kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Couple ka moment = F·d = 40 × 0.25 = 10 N·m, aur ye har point ke about same hota hai, isliye P ke liye bhi 10 N·m. 80 N·m tab aata hai jab 2 m wali distance galti se multiply kar dete ho. Net force zero hone se moment zero nahi hota — couple ka poora matlab yahi hai.

questions.question: Force F = (3i + 4j) N, point r = (2i + 1j) m par lagi hai. Origin O ke about iska moment kya hai? (CCW positive)
questions.explanation: M_O = x·Fy − y·Fx = 2·4 − 1·3 = 8 − 3 = 5 N·m. Positive hai, to CCW. 11 N·m tab aata hai jab dono terms jod dete ho (minus sign bhool kar). 11.2 N·m = |r|·|F| = √5 × 5, jo sirf tab sahi hota jab r aur F perpendicular hote.

questions.question: Ek point par do forces hain: F1 = 100 N, +x axis ke along (0°), aur F2 = 60 N, +x axis se 120° par. Resultant ka magnitude kya hai?
questions.explanation: Rx = 100 + 60 cos120° = 100 − 30 = 70 N, Ry = 60 sin120° = 52.0 N. |R| = √(70² + 52.0²) = 87.2 N. 140 N tab aata hai jab cos120° ki jagah cos60° le lete ho (forces ke beech ka angle 120° hai, 60° nahi). 116.6 N unhe perpendicular maan kar aata hai aur 160 N scalar sum hai.

questions.question: Ek horizontal bar AB, 0.8 m lambi hai. End B par 500 N ki vertical force neeche ki taraf lagi hai. Is force ko point A par ek equivalent force-couple system se replace karo.
options: A par 500 N neeche aur 200 N·m clockwise couple
A par 500 N neeche aur 400 N·m counter-clockwise couple
A par sirf 500 N neeche, koi couple nahi
A par 500 N neeche aur 400 N·m clockwise couple
questions.explanation: Force ko A par shift karo aur couple = B wali force ka A ke about moment = 500 × 0.8 = 400 N·m. B, A ke right me hai aur force neeche hai, to ye bar ko clockwise ghumati hai. Direction galat lena (CCW) sabse common trap hai; couple bhool jaana bhi galat hai, kyunki tab rotation ka effect gayab ho jaata hai.

questions.question: 6 m lambi horizontal beam, A par x = 0. Loads: x = 1 m par 8 kN neeche, x = 4 m par 4 kN neeche, aur x = 5 m par 12 kN·m ka clockwise couple. Is system ke single resultant force ki line of action A se kitni door hai?
questions.explanation: R = 8 + 4 = 12 kN neeche. A ke about moment (CCW +): −8·1 − 4·4 − 12 = −36 kN·m. Single force 12 kN neeche distance x par: −12x = −36, x = 3 m. Couple ko ignore karne par −24/12 = 2 m aata hai — couple resultant force nahi badalta par uski location zaroor badalta hai. Couple ka sign ulta lene par 1 m aata hai.

questions.question: 80 N ki force +x axis se 60° upar (anticlockwise) direction me lagi hai. Iska y-component Fy kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Fy = 80 sin60° = 69.3 N. 40.0 N, 80 cos60° hai — wo x-component hai, y nahi (sin/cos swap wala trap). 92.4 N, 80 ko sin60° se divide karne se aata hai; koi bhi component poori force se bada nahi ho sakta, aur 80.0 N to poori force hi hai.

questions.question: Riya ek spanner ke handle par, nut ke centre se 0.25 m door, 120 N ki force handle ke perpendicular lagati hai. Nut par moment kitna hai?
questions.explanation: M = F·d = 120 × 0.25 = 30 N·m; force handle ke perpendicular hai, to poori 0.25 m hi perpendicular distance hai. 480 N·m force ko distance se divide karne (120/0.25) se aata hai. 15 N·m me bina wajah ½ lag gaya, aur 120 N·m to sirf force hai, moment nahi.

questions.question: Ek rigid plate par 15 N·m ka couple laga hai. Is couple ko (same sense me) plate par kisi doosri jagah shift kar diya jaaye, to plate par effect ka kya hoga?
options: Shift distance × 15 ka naya couple jodna padega
Effect zero ho jaayega, kyunki net force zero hai
Moment shift distance ke saath badh jaayega
Effect same rahega; couple free vector hai
questions.explanation: Couple ka moment har point ke about same hota hai, isliye use rigid body par kahin bhi shift kar sakte ho, effect nahi badalta. Naya couple jodna sirf tab padta hai jab ek force ko shift karte ho, couple ko nahi — yahi trap hai. Net force zero hone se rotation ka effect khatam nahi hota.

questions.question: F = 50 N ki force +x axis se 60° upar direction me point P (3 m, 2 m) par lagi hai. Origin O ke about iska moment kya hai? (CCW positive)
questions.explanation: Fx = 50 cos60° = 25 N, Fy = 50 sin60° = 43.3 N. M_O = x·Fy − y·Fx = 3·43.3 − 2·25 = 129.9 − 50 = 79.9 N·m, positive hai to CCW. 179.9 N·m minus sign bhool kar dono terms jodne se aata hai. 180.3 N·m = |r|·|F| = √13 × 50, jo tabhi sahi hota jab r aur F perpendicular hote. Clockwise wala option sign ulta padhne ki galti hai.

questions.question: Ek point par teen forces hain: F1 = 40 N (+x direction), F2 = 30 N (+y direction) aur F3 = 20 N (−x direction). Resultant ka magnitude kya hai?
questions.explanation: Rx = 40 − 20 = 20 N, Ry = 30 N, to |R| = √(20² + 30²) = 36.1 N. 90.0 N scalar sum hai (directions ignore karke). 67.1 N tab aata hai jab F3 ko bhi +x me jod dete ho (Rx = 60). 50.0 N, F3 ko bhool kar sirf 40 aur 30 ka resultant hai.

questions.question: 6 m lambi horizontal beam, A par x = 0. Loads: x = 2 m par 6 kN neeche, x = 5 m par 4 kN upar, x = 6 m par 10 kN neeche, aur ek 8 kN·m ka counter-clockwise couple. Is system ke single resultant force ki line of action A se kitni door hai? (Upar positive, CCW positive)
questions.explanation: R = −6 + 4 − 10 = −12 kN (12 kN neeche). M_A = 2(−6) + 5(4) + 6(−10) + 8 = −12 + 20 − 60 + 8 = −44 kN·m. Single force: −12x = −44, to x = 3.67 m. 4.33 m couple ko ignore karne (−52/−12) se aata hai, aur 5.00 m couple ka sign ulta lene (−60/−12) se. 4.20 m tab aata hai jab 4 kN upar wali force ko bhi neeche maan lete ho (−84/−20).

questions.question: Force F = (4j + 3k) N point r = (2i + 1j) m par lagi hai. Origin se guzarne wali aur unit vector λ = (0.6i + 0.8j) ke along axis ke about F ka moment kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Pehle M_O = r × F = (1·3 − 0·4)i − (2·3 − 0·0)j + (2·4 − 1·0)k = (3i − 6j + 8k) N·m. Axis ke about moment = λ · M_O = 0.6·3 + 0.8·(−6) = 1.8 − 4.8 = −3.0 N·m (minus = λ ke ulte sense me). +6.6 N·m j-component ka minus bhoolne se aata hai. 10.4 N·m = |M_O| = √109, jo poore moment ka magnitude hai, axis wala component nahi. +3.0 N·m ulta order (F × r) lene se aata hai.

questions.question: Ek bracket par point B, point A se (0.4 m, 0.3 m) par hai (x right, y upar). B par 300 N ki force lagi hai jo horizontal se 60° neeche, right ki taraf point karti hai. Is force ko A par equivalent force-couple system se replace karo. A par couple kitna hoga?
questions.explanation: Fx = 300 cos60° = 150 N, Fy = −300 sin60° = −259.8 N. M_A = x·Fy − y·Fx = 0.4(−259.8) − 0.3(150) = −103.9 − 45 = −148.9 N·m, yaani 148.9 N·m clockwise; A par force wahi 300 N rahegi. 58.9 N·m tab aata hai jab y·Fx term ka sign ulta lete ho. 150.0 N·m = |r|·|F| = 0.5 × 300, yaani perpendicular distance ki jagah poori distance. CCW sign padhne ki galti hai.

questions.question: Ek plate par do couples hain: pehla do 50 N forces se jinki lines 0.4 m door hain (CCW), aur doosra do 30 N forces se jinki lines 0.5 m door hain (clockwise). Inka net effect do vertical forces ke ek couple se dena hai jinki lines 0.25 m door hon. Har force kitni honi chahiye?
questions.explanation: Couples free vectors hain, to seedha jodo: 50 × 0.4 = 20 N·m CCW aur 30 × 0.5 = 15 N·m clockwise, net = 5 N·m CCW. Naya couple: F × 0.25 = 5, to F = 20 N (CCW sense me). 140 N dono couples ko same sense ka maan kar (35/0.25) aata hai. 1.25 N divide ki jagah multiply (5 × 0.25) karne se aata hai, aur 35 N moments ke sum ko hi force maan lene se.

weeks.title: Equilibrium of rigid bodies
weeks.summary: Is week aap free body diagram banana, pin, roller aur fixed supports ke reactions pehchaanna, aur 2D equilibrium ki teen equations se unknown forces nikaalna seekhoge.
concepts: **Free body diagram (FBD)**: body ko uske supports se 'alag' karke draw karo, aur har support ki jagah uska reaction force/moment lagao. Saath me saare applied loads, weight (centre of gravity par) aur dimensions likho. Galat FBD = galat answer, isliye ye step kabhi skip mat karo.

**Support reactions (2D)**: roller ya smooth surface = 1 unknown (surface ke perpendicular force). Pin (hinge) = 2 unknowns (Rx, Ry). Fixed support = 3 unknowns (Rx, Ry aur ek reaction moment M). Cable ya rope = 1 unknown, tension jo cable ke along body se door kheenchti hai.
**Equilibrium equations**: 2D rigid body ke liye ΣFx = 0, ΣFy = 0, ΣM = 0 (kisi bhi point ke about). Yaani ek body se maximum 3 unknowns nikal sakte ho.

**Smart moment point**: moment us point ke about lo jahan se zyada se zyada unknown forces guzarti hain. Jaise pin A ke about moment lene se Ax aur Ay dono gayab, aur ek hi equation me roller reaction mil jaata hai.

**Two-force member**: jis body par sirf do points par force lagti hai (aur koi moment nahi), wahan dono forces barabar, opposite aur un do points ko jodne wali line ke along hoti hain. Truss members aur links aise hi hote hain.

**Three-force member aur Lami's theorem**: teen non-parallel forces equilibrium me hon to wo ek point se guzarti hain (concurrent). Concurrent teen forces ke liye Lami's theorem: F1/sinα = F2/sinβ = F3/sinγ, jahan har angle baaki do forces ke beech ka angle hai.

**Static determinacy**: agar unknowns = available equations (2D single body me 3), to body statically determinate hai. Unknowns zyada hon to indeterminate (sirf statics se solve nahi hoga); kam hon ya reactions galat arrange hon (jaise teeno reactions parallel) to body unstable (mechanism) hai.
**Sign check**: koi reaction negative aaye to iska matlab hai ki uski asli direction FBD me assume ki gayi direction ke ulti hai. Magnitude sahi hai, bas direction palat do.

example.problem: Horizontal bar AB, 4 m lambi, A par pin aur B par roller (horizontal surface par). A se 3 m door point C par 10 kN ki force lagi hai jo horizontal se 60° neeche, right ki taraf point karti hai. Bar ka weight neglect karo. A aur B ke reactions nikalo.
steps: Force ke components: right ki taraf 10 cos60° = 5 kN, neeche ki taraf 10 sin60° = 8.66 kN.
FBD: A par Ax aur Ay (pin), B par sirf By (roller, vertical). Teen unknowns, teen equations.
ΣFy = 0: Ay + 6.50 − 8.66 = 0, to Ay = 2.17 kN upar.
ΣFx = 0: Ax + 5 = 0, to Ax = −5 kN, yaani 5 kN left ki taraf (horizontal component sirf pin hi le sakta hai, roller nahi).
Answer: **Ax = 5 kN (left), Ay = 2.17 kN (upar), By = 6.50 kN (upar)**.
example.code:
A───────────C────B
^           ↘    o
|←── 3 m ──→|←1m→|

^ = pin at A, o = roller at B
↘ = 10 kN at 60° below horizontal

mistakes: Roller par horizontal reaction maan lena. Roller sirf surface ke perpendicular force deta hai; horizontal force pin ya fixed support hi le sakta hai.
Fixed support (cantilever) par reaction moment bhool jaana. Fixed end par Rx, Ry ke saath ek moment bhi hota hai, warna ΣM = 0 satisfy hi nahi hoga.
Inclined force ka moment poori force × distance se lena. Pehle components me todo; jo component moment point se guzarta hai uska moment zero hai.
revision: Roller: 1 reaction, pin: 2, fixed: 3 (Rx, Ry, M).
2D: ΣFx = 0, ΣFy = 0, ΣM = 0.
Moment us point ke about lo jahan sabse zyada unknowns milte hain.
Two-force member: forces do points ko jodne wali line ke along.
Unknowns > 3: indeterminate; reactions concurrent ya parallel: unstable.

questions.question: 2D problem me ek fixed (built-in) support kitne unknown reaction components deta hai?
questions.explanation: Fixed support na translate hone deta hai (Rx, Ry) na rotate (reaction moment M), to 3 unknowns. 2 pin ka answer hai — fixed support aur pin me farak yahi moment hai. 1 roller ka hai.

questions.question: 5 kg ka lamp do cables se latka hai. Dono cables symmetric hain aur har ek horizontal se 30° par hai. Har cable me tension kitni hai? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Weight = 5 × 9.81 = 49.05 N. Vertical equilibrium: 2T sin30° = 49.05, to T = 49.05 / (2 × 0.5) = 49.1 N. 24.5 N weight ko seedha do me baantne se aata hai (angle bhool kar). 28.3 N tab aata hai jab sin ki jagah cos le lete ho — angle horizontal se diya hai, isliye vertical component T sin30° hai.

questions.question: Cantilever AB, 3 m lamba, A par wall me fixed hai aur B free end hai (beam A se right ki taraf jaati hai). A se 1 m par 2 kN neeche aur B par 4 kN neeche load hai. Beam weight neglect karo. A par reaction moment kya hai?
questions.explanation: Loads ka A ke about moment = 2·1 + 4·3 = 14 kN·m clockwise, isliye wall ko 14 kN·m counter-clockwise moment dena padega. Direction ulta likhna (loads wali direction) sabse common trap hai. 18 kN·m tab aata hai jab total 6 kN ko 3 m se multiply kar dete ho, aur 6 kN·m force aur moment ko mix karne se.

questions.question: 200 N ka block point C se latka hai. C se ek rope CA horizontal jaakar wall se bandhi hai, aur doosri rope CB upar ceiling tak jaati hai aur vertical se 40° par hai. Rope CA me tension kitni hai?
questions.explanation: Joint C: vertical: T_CB cos40° = 200, to T_CB = 261.1 N. Horizontal: T_CA = T_CB sin40° = 200 tan40° = 167.8 N. 238.4 N = 200/tan40°, jo tab aata hai jab angle ko horizontal se maan lete ho. 128.6 N aur 153.2 N, 200 ko seedha sin ya cos se multiply karne se aate hain.

questions.question: Ek horizontal beam ke dono ends A aur B par pin supports hain (dono pins, koi roller nahi). Vertical loads lage hain. Ye beam kya hai?
questions.explanation: Do pins = 2 + 2 = 4 unknowns, par 2D me sirf 3 equations, to degree of indeterminacy 4 − 3 = 1. Vertical loads hone par bhi Ax aur Bx alag-alag nahi nikal sakte, sirf unka sum (Ax + Bx = 0) milta hai. 'Determinate' wahi galti hai jahan reactions count karna bhool jaate ho.

questions.question: Uniform horizontal bar AB, 2 m lamba, weight 200 N, A par wall se pinned hai. End B se ek cable upar wall par point C tak jaati hai aur bar ke saath 30° banati hai. B par 400 N ka weight latka hai. Pin A par horizontal reaction kitna hai?
questions.explanation: ΣM_A = 0: T sin30°·2 = 200·1 + 400·2 = 1000, to T = 1000 N. Horizontal: Ax = T cos30° = 866.0 N (wall ki taraf se bahar push). 692.8 N tab aata hai jab bar ka 200 N weight bhool jaate ho (T = 800 N). 1000 N cable tension hai, reaction nahi, aur 500 N uska vertical component hai.

questions.question: Horizontal surface par rakha roller support beam ko kis direction me reaction deta hai?
options: Ek force aur ek reaction moment
questions.explanation: Roller surface par aage-peeche ghoom sakta hai, to wo surface ke along koi force nahi de sakta — sirf perpendicular force, yaani 1 unknown. Dono components pin dete hain, aur force ke saath moment fixed support deta hai. Roller par parallel (horizontal) force maan lena sabse common FBD galti hai.

questions.question: Simply supported beam AB, span 5 m (A par pin, B par roller). A se 2 m par 20 kN ka vertical load neeche hai. Reaction R_B kitna hai?
questions.explanation: ΣM_A = 0: R_B·5 = 20·2, to R_B = 8 kN, aur R_A = 20 − 8 = 12 kN. 12 kN, R_A hai — load A ke paas hai, isliye A zyada uthata hai aur B kam. 10 kN tab hota jab load beech me hota. 40 kN force × distance hai, span se divide karna bhool kar.

questions.question: Ek seedha, weightless link AB dono ends par smooth pins se juda hai aur beech me koi load nahi hai. Link par lagne wali forces ki direction kya hogi?
options: AB ke along, barabar aur opposite
Kisi bhi direction me, pins par depend
questions.explanation: Ye two-force member hai: sirf do points par force, koi moment nahi. ΣM = 0 tabhi hoga jab dono forces un do points ko jodne wali line ke along hon, aur ΣF = 0 se wo barabar aur opposite hain. Perpendicular forces ek couple banaati jo balance nahi hota. Weight neglect hai, to gravity wala reason bhi galat hai.

questions.question: 100 N ka weight ek ring se latka hai jo do strings se bandhi hai: left string horizontal se 30° par aur right string horizontal se 60° par. Right (60° wali) string me tension kitni hai?
questions.explanation: Horizontal: T₁ cos30° = T₂ cos60°, to T₁ = 0.577 T₂. Vertical: T₁ sin30° + T₂ sin60° = 100 ⇒ T₂(0.289 + 0.866) = 100, T₂ = 86.6 N (aur T₁ = 50.0 N). Lami se bhi: strings ke beech 90°, to T₂ = 100 sin120°/sin90° = 86.6 N. 50.0 N doosri string ki tension hai. 115.5 N = 100/sin60°, jo tab hota jab akeli ek string poora weight uthaati.

questions.question: Simply supported beam AB, span 6 m (A par pin, B par roller). A se 4 m par 20 kN ki force lagi hai jo beam ke saath 30° banati hai (neeche ki taraf, inclined). Roller reaction R_B kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Moment me sirf vertical component kaam aata hai (horizontal component beam ki line par hai): 20 sin30° = 10 kN. ΣM_A: R_B·6 = 10·4, R_B = 6.67 kN. 13.33 kN poori 20 kN force ko vertical maan lene se aata hai. 11.55 kN tab aata hai jab cos30° wala component (17.32 kN) le lete ho. 3.33 kN, R_A hai.

questions.question: Cantilever AB, 2 m lamba, A par wall me fixed hai (beam A se right jaati hai). Free end B par 5 kN ki force horizontal se 30° neeche, right ki taraf (wall se door) lagi hai. Beam ke beech me 4 kN·m ka counter-clockwise couple bhi hai. A par reaction moment kya hai?
questions.explanation: B par components: horizontal 4.33 kN (beam ki line par, moment zero) aur vertical 5 sin30° = 2.5 kN neeche. Loads ka A ke about moment: −2.5 × 2 + 4 = −1 kN·m (clockwise), to wall M_A = 1 kN·m CCW deti hai. 5 kN·m couple ko bhool jaane se aata hai. 6 kN·m poori 5 kN force × 2 m lene (10 − 4) se, aur 9 kN·m couple ka sign ulta lene (5 + 4) se.

questions.question: 500 N ka smooth sphere ek V-groove me pada hai jiski do smooth walls horizontal se 30° aur 45° par inclined hain. 30° wali wall ka normal reaction kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Har wall ka reaction wall ke perpendicular hai, to N₁ vertical se 30° aur N₂ vertical se 45° par (opposite sides). Lami: N₁ aur N₂ ke beech 75°; N₁ ke saamne wala angle (N₂ aur W ke beech) 135° hai. N₁ = 500 sin135°/sin75° = 366.0 N, aur N₂ = 500 sin150°/sin75° = 258.8 N. 258.8 N dono reactions ko swap karna hai. 433.0 N = 500 cos30°, jo akele incline par rakhe block ka answer hai, groove ka nahi. 250.0 N weight ko seedha half karna hai.

questions.question: Horizontal beam AB, 4 m lamba, A par pin hai. B par roller ek aise surface par hai jo horizontal se 30° inclined hai, isliye B ka reaction vertical se 30° par hai. Beam ke beech me 12 kN ka vertical load neeche hai. Pin A par horizontal reaction ka magnitude kitna hai?
questions.explanation: R_B ke components: vertical R_B cos30°, horizontal R_B sin30°. ΣM_A: R_B cos30° × 4 = 12 × 2, to R_B = 6/0.866 = 6.93 kN. ΣFx: A_x, R_B ke horizontal component ko balance karta hai: R_B sin30° = 3.46 kN. 0 kN tab aata hai jab roller ka reaction vertical maan lete ho. 6.93 kN khud R_B hai. 3.00 kN tab aata hai jab R_B = 6 kN (cos30° bhool kar) le kar uska half lete ho.

questions.question: Uniform horizontal beam AB, 3 m lamba, weight 600 N, A par pin hai. A se 2 m par point C se ek vertical cable upar jaati hai, aur end B par 900 N ka load latka hai. Pin A par vertical reaction kya hai?
questions.explanation: ΣM_A: T·2 = 600·1.5 + 900·3 = 3600, to T = 1800 N. ΣFy: A_y + 1800 − 600 − 900 = 0, A_y = −300 N, yaani 300 N neeche — cable C par hai aur bada load B par, to beam C ke about ghoom kar A wale end ko upar uthana chahti hai. "300 N upar" sign check na karne se aata hai. 450 N neeche beam ka weight bhool jaane se (T = 1350 N). 1500 N upar cable ko bhool kar saare loads A par daal dene se.

weeks.title: Plane trusses: joints, sections and zero-force members
weeks.summary: Is week aap truss ke members me force nikalna seekhoge: method of joints, method of sections, aur zero-force members ko bina calculation pehchaanna.
concepts: **Truss**: seedhe members jo apne ends par pins se jude hain, aur loads sirf joints par lagte hain. Isliye har member ek **two-force member** hai: uski force member ke axis ke along hi hoti hai, ya to tension (T) ya compression (C).

**Sign convention**: member force ko pehle tension maan kar joint se door (member ke andar ki taraf) kheenchta hua draw karo. Answer positive aaye to tension, negative aaye to compression. Isse har joint par direction ka confusion khatam ho jaata hai.

**Method of joints**: har joint ek concurrent force system hai, to har joint se sirf 2 equations milti hain (ΣFx = 0, ΣFy = 0). Isliye shuruaat us joint se karo jahan sirf 2 unknown members hon — aksar support wala joint, reactions nikaalne ke baad.

**Method of sections**: truss ko ek imaginary line se kaato jo zyada se zyada 3 unknown members ko kaate, phir ek hissa (left ya right) ko rigid body maan kar 3 equations lagao. Jis member ki force chahiye, baaki do members ki lines jahan milti hain us point ke about moment lo — ek hi equation me answer.
**Zero-force members (rule 1)**: kisi unloaded joint par sirf do members milte hon aur wo collinear na hon, to dono members ki force zero hai.

**Zero-force members (rule 2)**: kisi unloaded joint par teen members milte hon jinme se do collinear hain, to teesre member ki force zero hai, aur collinear wale dono members ki force barabar hai. Zero-force members bekaar nahi hain — wo stability dete hain aur load badalne par kaam aate hain.

**Determinacy check**: m = members, r = reactions, j = joints. Agar m + r = 2j to truss statically determinate hai (agar members sahi arrange hain), m + r > 2j to indeterminate, aur m + r < 2j to unstable.

example.problem: Triangular truss ABC: A (0, 0) par pin, B (4 m, 0) par roller, aur apex C (2 m, 2 m) par 10 kN ki vertical load neeche. Members AB (horizontal) aur AC me force nikalo, tension ya compression batao.
steps: Symmetry se reactions: Ay = By = 5 kN upar, Ax = 0.
AC ka angle: rise 2 m, run 2 m, to horizontal se 45°.
Joint A par AB aur AC dono ko tension maano (joint se door). ΣFy: 5 + F_AC sin45° = 0, to F_AC = −5/0.707 = −7.07 kN.
ΣFx at A: F_AB + F_AC cos45° = 0, to F_AB = −(−7.07)(0.707) = +5 kN.
Negative = compression, positive = tension. AC load ko neeche support tak push kar raha hai, aur AB dono supports ko bahar phailne se rok raha hai — physically bhi sense banta hai.
Answer: **F_AC = 7.07 kN (C), F_AB = 5 kN (T)**.

mistakes: Member force ki direction har joint par alag-alag guess karna. Hamesha tension assume karo (joint se door arrow); sign khud batayega ki compression hai.
Method of sections me 3 se zyada unknown members kaat dena. Ek rigid hisse se sirf 3 equations milti hain, to cut aise lagao ki max 3 unknown members kate.
Loaded joint par zero-force rule laga dena. Rule sirf tab chalta hai jab us joint par koi external load ya reaction na ho.
revision: Truss member = two-force member, force axis ke along.
Tension assume karo: + = T, − = C.
Joints: 2 equations per joint; sections: 3 equations per cut.
Unloaded joint, 2 non-collinear members: dono zero.
Unloaded joint, 3 members (2 collinear): teesra zero.
Determinate: m + r = 2j.

questions.question: Ek truss ke kisi joint par koi external load ya support nahi hai, aur wahan sirf do members milte hain jo ek line me (collinear) nahi hain. In dono members ki forces ke baare me kya sahi hai?
options: Dono barabar aur opposite hain, par non-zero
Dono members ki force zero hai
Baaki truss ke loads jaane bina kuch nahi keh sakte
questions.explanation: Do non-collinear forces ka sum zero tabhi ho sakta hai jab dono zero hon — ek ka component doosra cancel hi nahi kar sakta. Isliye ye bina calculation ke hi pata chal jaata hai. 'Barabar aur opposite' sirf collinear members ke liye possible hai.

questions.question: Ek plane truss me 6 joints, 9 members aur supports se 3 reaction components hain (ek pin, ek roller). Determinacy ke baare me kya kaha ja sakta hai?
options: Statically determinate (agar members sahi arrange hain)
questions.explanation: m + r = 9 + 3 = 12 aur 2j = 2 × 6 = 12. Barabar hain, to unknowns = equations, aur truss determinate hai (agar members aise arrange hain ki shape stable hai). Galti tab hoti hai jab 2j ki jagah sirf j ya 3j se compare karte ho.

questions.question: Triangular truss: A (0, 0) par pin, B (6 m, 0) par roller, apex C (3 m, 4 m) par 12 kN vertical load neeche. Horizontal member AB me force kya hai?
questions.explanation: Reactions 6 kN each. AC ki length 5 m, to sinθ = 4/5, cosθ = 3/5. Joint A: F_AC·(4/5) + 6 = 0, F_AC = −7.5 kN (C). ΣFx: F_AB + F_AC·(3/5) = 0, F_AB = +4.5 kN, yaani tension. 7.5 kN compression AC ki force hai, AB ki nahi. 8.0 kN tab aata hai jab sin aur cos ulte lagate ho.

questions.question: Neeche diye bridge truss me bottom joints A, B, C, D, E har 3 m par hain (A par x = 0, E par x = 12 m). Top joints F, G, H, B, C, D ke theek upar 3 m height par hain. Members: AB, BC, CD, DE, FG, GH, AF, HE, FB, GC, HD, FC, HC. A par pin, E par roller, aur B, C, D par 10 kN neeche. Kaunsa member zero-force member hai?
questions.explanation: Joint G par teen members hain: FG aur GH collinear (dono horizontal) aur GC vertical, aur G par koi load nahi. Rule 2 se GC = 0. Trap FB hai: B par bhi wahi pattern dikhta hai (AB, BC collinear + FB), par B par 10 kN load laga hai, isliye FB = 10 kN tension, zero nahi.

questions.question: Usi bridge truss me (bottom joints 3 m par, height 3 m, A par pin, E par roller, B, C, D par 10 kN neeche), top chord member FG me force kya hai? Section members FG, FC aur BC ko kaatta hai.
questions.explanation: Reactions: Ay = Ey = 15 kN. Left hissa lo aur C (x = 6, y = 0) ke about moment lo — FC aur BC dono C se guzarte hain. clockwise + lekar: 15·6 − 10·3 + F_FG·3 = 0 (F_FG ko tension assume kiya: F par G ki taraf, yaani right kheenchti hai, aur C se 3 m upar hai), to F_FG = −20 kN, yaani 20 kN compression. 30 kN tab aata hai jab B wala 10 kN load bhool jaate ho; 15 kN bottom chord BC ki force hai.

questions.question: Usi bridge truss me (A par pin, E par roller, B, C, D par 10 kN neeche, panel 3 m × 3 m), diagonal FC me force kya hai?
questions.explanation: Wahi section (FG, FC, BC) lo. FG aur BC horizontal hain, to vertical equilibrium sirf FC se: FC, F se C ki taraf 45° neeche jaata hai. ΣFy: 15 − 10 − F_FC sin45° = 0, to F_FC = 5/0.707 = +7.07 kN, tension. 5.0 kN tab aata hai jab 45° angle bhool kar poora vertical shear FC ko de dete ho. 21.2 kN end diagonal AF ki force hai (aur wo compression hai).

questions.question: Ideal plane truss ke kisi member me force ke baare me kya sahi hai?
options: Axis ke along force aur saath me bending moment
Joint par depend, kisi bhi direction me
Member ke axis ke along (T ya C)
questions.explanation: Truss ke members ends par pins se jude hain aur load sirf joints par lagte hain, to har member two-force member hai — force sirf axis ke along, tension ya compression. Bending moment tab aata jab load member ke beech me lagta; ideal truss me aisa nahi hota. Shear wala option beam wali soch hai.

questions.question: Ek plane truss me 5 joints, 8 members aur supports se 3 reaction components hain. Ye truss kya hai?
questions.explanation: m + r = 8 + 3 = 11 aur 2j = 2 × 5 = 10. 11 > 10, to ek unknown extra hai: indeterminate, degree 1. "Determinate" tab hota jab m + r = 2j hota (7 members). "Unstable" m + r < 2j par hota hai — yahan ulta hai. Degree 3 ka koi aadhaar nahi — extra unknowns sirf 11 − 10 = 1 hain.

questions.question: Truss ke ek unloaded joint par teen members milte hain: do collinear aur teesra alag direction me. Collinear members ki forces ke baare me kya sahi hai?
questions.explanation: Collinear line ke perpendicular ΣF lo: sirf teesra member us direction me component deta hai, to wo zero hai. Phir collinear line ke along ΣF = 0 se dono collinear members ki force barabar (dono T ya dono C). "Dono zero" rule 1 (sirf do non-collinear members) se confuse karna hai. Ek T aur ek C tab hota jab dono joint ko same direction me kheenchte — tension convention me dono same type nikalte hain.

questions.question: Triangular truss: A (0, 0) par pin, B (8 m, 0) par roller, apex C (4 m, 3 m) par 18 kN vertical load neeche. Member AC me force kya hai?
questions.explanation: Symmetry se A_y = B_y = 9 kN. AC ki length 5 m, sinθ = 3/5, cosθ = 4/5. Joint A (AC ko tension maan kar): F_AC·(3/5) + 9 = 0, F_AC = −15 kN, yaani compression. 12 kN tension AB ki force hai (−F_AC·4/5). 11.25 kN sin aur cos swap karne (9/0.8) se aata hai, aur "15 kN tension" minus sign ignore karne se.

questions.question: Neeche diye bridge truss me bottom joints har 3 m par hain aur height 3 m hai. A par pin, E par roller, aur B, C, D har joint par 10 kN neeche. Bottom member AB me force kya hai?
questions.explanation: Symmetry se A_y = 15 kN. Joint A par sirf AB (horizontal) aur AF (45°). ΣFy: 15 + F_AF sin45° = 0, F_AF = −21.2 kN (C). ΣFx: F_AB + F_AF cos45° = 0, F_AB = +15 kN, yaani tension. 21.2 kN compression AF ki force hai, AB ki nahi. 10.6 kN tab aata hai jab 15 ko seedha cos45° se multiply kar dete ho. "15 kN compression" sign galat padhna hai — bottom chord supports ko bahar phailne se rokta hai, isliye tension.

questions.question: Neeche diye bridge truss me (bottom joints 3 m par, height 3 m, A par pin, E par roller) ab sirf joint C par 18 kN neeche load hai; B aur D par koi load nahi. Kaunse members zero-force members hain?
options: FB aur HD, par GC nahi
Koi nahi, kyunki truss loaded hai
questions.explanation: Joint B: AB aur BC collinear, FB alag, aur ab B par koi load nahi — rule 2 se FB = 0. Isi tarah D par (CD, DE collinear) HD = 0, aur G par (FG, GH collinear) GC = 0. "Sirf GC" purani loading (B, D bhi loaded) ka answer hai — load badla to zero-force members bhi badal gaye. Truss loaded hone se har member loaded nahi ho jaata; rule har joint par alag lagta hai.

questions.question: Neeche diye bridge truss me sirf joint C par 18 kN neeche load hai (A par pin, E par roller, panel 3 m × 3 m). Top member FG me force kya hai? Section FG, FC aur BC ko kaatta hai.
questions.explanation: Symmetry se A_y = E_y = 9 kN. Left hissa lo aur C ke about moment lo (FC aur BC dono C se guzarte hain): A_y ka moment 9 × 6 = 54 kN·m clockwise. FG, C se 3 m upar hai, to F_FG × 3 ko ise balance karna hai: |F_FG| = 18 kN, aur tension maan kar sign negative aata hai, yaani compression (top chord dabti hai). "18 kN tension" sign galat padhne se. 9 kN, A_y ka arm 6 m ki jagah 3 m lene se, aur 36 kN poora 18 kN ek hi support par daal dene se.

questions.question: Ek wall-mounted truss me joint A (0, 0) aur joint B (0, 2 m) dono wall par pins hain. Tip C (3 m, 0) par hai, aur members sirf AC (horizontal) aur BC (inclined) hain. C par 12 kN vertical load neeche hai. Member BC me force kya hai?

"Compression" sign ulta lena hai.

questions.question: Neeche diye bridge truss me sirf joint B par 20 kN neeche load hai (A par pin, E par roller, bottom joints 3 m par, height 3 m). Top member GH me force kya hai?
questions.explanation: Reactions: E_y·12 = 20·3, to E_y = 5 kN aur A_y = 15 kN. Section GH, HC aur CD ko kaato aur right hissa lo (us par sirf E_y = 5 kN, koi load nahi). C ke about moment: E_y ka arm 6 m, to 5 × 6 = 30 kN·m, jise GH (C se 3 m upar) balance karta hai: |F_GH| = 30/3 = 10 kN, compression. 30 kN compression tab aata hai jab left hissa lekar B wala 20 kN load bhool jaate ho (15 × 6/3). 5 kN, E_y ka arm 6 m ki jagah 3 m lene se aata hai.

weeks.title: Beams: reactions, shear force and bending moment
weeks.summary: Is week aap beams par point aur distributed loads ke reactions nikalna, kisi bhi section par shear force aur bending moment calculate karna, aur SFD/BMD draw karna seekhoge.
concepts: **Beam types**: simply supported (ek end pin, doosra roller), cantilever (ek end fixed, doosra free), aur overhanging (load support ke bahar tak jaata hai). Teeno 2D me statically determinate hain, to reactions week 2 ki teen equations se nikalte hain.

**Distributed load ka equivalent**: reactions ke liye distributed load ko ek point load se replace karo jiska magnitude = load diagram ka area aur location = area ka centroid. UDL w over length L: wL, beech me. Triangular load (0 se w tak) over L: ½wL, bade end se L/3 par (chhote end se 2L/3).

**Internal forces**: beam ko kisi section x par kaato to wahan teen internal quantities hoti hain: shear force V, bending moment M (aur axial force, jo yahan zero hai). Inhe nikaalne ke liye section ke left hisse ka FBD lo.

**Sign convention**: is course me V = section ke left hisse par saare upward forces ka sum (left me upar = positive shear). M = left hisse ki saari forces ka section ke about clockwise moment; positive M = **sagging** (beam neeche ki taraf smile jaisi mudti hai), negative = hogging.

**SFD aur BMD shapes**: do loads ke beech koi load na ho to V constant aur M linear. Point load par V me utna hi jump (step). UDL ke under V linear aur M parabola. Simply supported beam ke ends par M = 0, cantilever ke free end par V = 0 aur M = 0.
**Maximum bending moment** wahan hota hai jahan V zero ho ya sign badle. Point load ke neeche V seedha positive se negative jump kar sakta hai — tab M max usi point par hai.

**Yaad rakhne layak results**: simply supported, beech me point load P: M_max = PL/4. Simply supported, poori span par UDL w: M_max = wL²/8 (beech me). Cantilever, free end par P: fixed end par |M| = PL. Cantilever, poori length par UDL: fixed end par |M| = wL²/2.

example.problem: Simply supported beam AB, span 6 m (A par pin, B par roller). Poori span par 4 kN/m UDL neeche, aur A se 2 m par 12 kN point load neeche. Reactions, SFD ke key values aur maximum bending moment nikalo.
steps: UDL ka total = 4 × 6 = 24 kN, beech me (x = 3 m).
Shear (0 < x < 2): V = 20 − 4x. A par V = 20 kN, x = 2 m ke just left me V = 12 kN.
x = 2 m par 12 kN load se V me 12 kN ka jump: just right me V = 0, phir V = −4(x − 2), aur B par V = −16 kN (jo −R_B ke barabar hai, check ✓).
V ka sign x = 2 m par badalta hai, to M max wahin hai.
Answer: **R_A = 20 kN, R_B = 16 kN, M_max = 32 kN·m (sagging) at x = 2 m**.

mistakes: Triangular load ka resultant beech me rakh dena. Triangle ka centroid bade end se L/3 par hota hai, beech me nahi.
Max bending moment hamesha beam ke beech me maan lena. Max M wahan hai jahan V = 0 ya sign badalta hai; unsymmetric loading me ye beech se hat jaata hai.
Section ke left aur right dono taraf ki forces ek saath jod dena. Sirf ek hissa lo (aam taur par left), warna answer zero ya double aayega.
revision: UDL: wL at centre; triangle: ½wL at L/3 from the big end.
V = Σ (upward forces on left); M = Σ clockwise moments of left forces.
Point load: V me step; UDL: V linear, M parabolic.
M_max jahan V = 0 ya sign change.
SS: PL/4 (central P), wL²/8 (UDL). Cantilever: PL, wL²/2.

questions.question: Simply supported beam, span 6 m, ke theek beech me 20 kN ka point load hai. Maximum bending moment kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Dono reactions 10 kN. Beech me M = 10 × 3 = 30 kN·m, yaani PL/4 = 20 × 6/4. 60 kN·m tab aata hai jab reaction (10 kN) ki jagah poora 20 kN load aadhi span (3 m) se multiply kar dete ho. 15 kN·m UDL wale formula (PL/8) se aata hai.

questions.question: 2 m lamba cantilever, poori length par 3 kN/m UDL. Fixed end par bending moment ka magnitude kya hai?
questions.explanation: Total load = 3 × 2 = 6 kN, jo fixed end se 1 m (beech) par act karta hai. |M| = 6 × 1 = 6 kN·m = wL²/2. 12 kN·m tab aata hai jab load ko free end par maan lete ho (6 × 2). 1.5 kN·m simply supported beam ka wL²/8 hai, jo cantilever par lagta hi nahi.

questions.question: Simply supported beam AB, span 6 m. Uspar triangular load hai jo A par 0 se badh kar B par 6 kN/m ho jaata hai. Reaction R_A kya hai?
questions.explanation: Total load = ½ × 6 × 6 = 18 kN, centroid bade end (B) se 6/3 = 2 m par, yaani A se 4 m par. ΣM_A: R_B·6 = 18·4, R_B = 12 kN, to R_A = 6 kN. 9 kN tab aata hai jab resultant ko beech me rakh dete ho. 12 kN R_B hai — load B ki taraf zyada hai, isliye B zyada uthata hai.

questions.question: Overhanging beam: A (x = 0) par pin, B (x = 4 m) par roller, aur beam x = 6 m (point C) tak jaati hai. C par 10 kN neeche load hai, aur koi load nahi. Reaction at A kya hai?
questions.explanation: ΣM_A: R_B·4 = 10·6, R_B = 15 kN upar. ΣFy: R_A + 15 − 10 = 0, R_A = −5 kN, yaani 5 kN neeche. Overhang par load beam ko B ke about 'see-saw' ki tarah ghumata hai aur A wala end upar uthna chahta hai, isliye A ko neeche kheenchna padta hai. '5 kN upar' sign check na karne se aata hai.

questions.question: Simply supported beam, span 10 m, A se 4 m par 30 kN point load. Load ke theek neeche bending moment kitna hai?
questions.explanation: R_A = 30 × 6/10 = 18 kN, R_B = 30 × 4/10 = 12 kN. Load ke neeche M = R_A × 4 = 72 kN·m (right side se bhi 12 × 6 = 72 ✓). 75 kN·m PL/4 hai, jo sirf central load ke liye hai. 48 kN·m tab aata hai jab galat reaction (12 kN) ko 4 m se multiply karte ho.

questions.question: Simply supported beam, span 8 m. Sirf left half par (x = 0 se 4 m tak) 6 kN/m UDL hai. Maximum bending moment kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Load = 24 kN at x = 2 m. R_B = 24·2/8 = 6 kN, R_A = 18 kN. V = 18 − 6x = 0 at x = 3 m. M(3) = 18·3 − 6·3²/2 = 54 − 27 = 27 kN·m. 24 kN·m midspan (x = 4) ka moment hai — max beech me nahi, V = 0 wale point par hota hai. 48 kN·m poori span par UDL maan kar wL²/8 se aata hai.

questions.question: 3 m lamba cantilever, free end par 5 kN ka point load. Fixed end par bending moment ka magnitude kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Free end ka load poori length ke arm se moment deta hai: |M| = PL = 5 × 3 = 15 kN·m. 7.5 kN·m load ko beech me maan lene se aata hai. 3.75 kN·m simply supported beam ka PL/4 hai, jo cantilever par lagta hi nahi. 5 kN·m force ko hi moment likh dena hai.

questions.question: Beam ki poori 5 m length par 2 kN/m ka UDL hai. Reactions nikalne ke liye ise kis equivalent point load se replace karoge?
options: 10 kN, kisi ek end se 5/3 m par
questions.explanation: UDL ka resultant = load diagram ka area = 2 × 5 = 10 kN, aur rectangle ka centroid beech me, yaani 2.5 m par. 5/3 m (L/3) triangular load ka rule hai, UDL ka nahi. 2 kN sirf intensity (kN/m) hai, force nahi. End par rakhne se moments galat aayenge.

questions.question: Simply supported beam, span 8 m, poori span par 4 kN/m ka UDL. Maximum bending moment kitna hai?
questions.explanation: M_max = wL²/8 = 4 × 64/8 = 32 kN·m, beech me. 128 kN·m cantilever wala wL²/2 hai. 64 kN·m tab aata hai jab total load (32 kN) ko central point load maan kar PL/4 lagate ho — wo formula sirf point load ke liye hai. 16 kN·m reaction (16 kN) ko hi moment likh dena hai.

questions.question: Simply supported beam AB, span 6 m. A se 2 m par 18 kN ka point load neeche hai. x = 4 m par shear force V kitna hai? (V = section ke left hisse par upward forces ka sum)
questions.explanation: R_A = 18 × 4/6 = 12 kN, R_B = 6 kN. x = 4 m ke left hisse par R_A = 12 upar aur 18 neeche: V = 12 − 18 = −6 kN. +6 kN sign convention ulta lene (right hisse ki forces ko left jaisa ginne) se aata hai. +12 kN load se pehle (x < 2 m) ka shear hai. −18 kN reaction bhool kar sirf load lene se.

questions.question: 3 m lambe cantilever par triangular load hai jo free end par 0 aur fixed end par 6 kN/m hai. Fixed end par bending moment ka magnitude kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Total load = ½ × 6 × 3 = 9 kN, centroid bade end (fixed end) se L/3 = 1 m par. |M| = 9 × 1 = 9 kN·m. 18 kN·m centroid ko chhote end se L/3 par (yaani fixed end se 2 m) rakhne se aata hai. 13.5 kN·m resultant ko beech me rakhne se, aur 27 kN·m UDL wala wL²/2 lagane se.

questions.question: Overhanging beam: A (x = 0) par pin, B (x = 6 m) par roller, aur beam x = 8 m tak jaati hai. Poori 8 m length par 3 kN/m ka UDL hai. A aur B ke beech maximum sagging (positive) bending moment kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Total 24 kN, x = 4 m par. ΣM_A: R_B·6 = 24·4, R_B = 16 kN, R_A = 8 kN. AB me V = 8 − 3x = 0 at x = 2.67 m. M = 8(2.67) − 1.5(2.67)² = 21.33 − 10.67 = 10.7 kN·m. 13.5 kN·m sirf 6 m span ka wL²/8 hai — overhang ka load B par hogging deta hai aur sagging ko kam karta hai. 24.0 kN·m poori 8 m ko simply supported maan kar, aur 6.0 kN·m B par ka hogging moment (3 × 2 × 1) hai, sagging nahi.

questions.question: Simply supported beam, span 9 m. A se 3 m par 15 kN aur 6 m par 6 kN, dono neeche. Maximum bending moment kitna hai?
questions.explanation: ΣM_A: R_B·9 = 15·3 + 6·6 = 81, R_B = 9 kN, R_A = 12 kN. M(3) = 12 × 3 = 36 kN·m, M(6) = 9 × 3 = 27 kN·m. V, x = 3 m par +12 se −3 ho jaata hai, to max wahin hai: 36 kN·m. 27 kN·m doosre load ke neeche ka moment hai. 47.3 kN·m dono loads ko ek 21 kN central load maan kar PL/4 se aata hai. 45 kN·m reaction ki jagah load (15 × 3) ko multiply karne se.

questions.question: Cantilever AB, 4 m lamba, A par fixed. Poori length par 2 kN/m ka UDL aur free end B par 5 kN ka point load. Beam ke beech (A se 2 m) par bending moment ka magnitude kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Section ke right (free) hisse ka FBD lo, reactions ki zaroorat nahi: UDL ka hissa 2 × 2 = 4 kN, section se 1 m par, aur 5 kN, section se 2 m par. |M| = 4 × 1 + 5 × 2 = 14 kN·m (hogging). 36 kN·m fixed end ka moment hai (16 + 20), beech ka nahi. 10 kN·m UDL bhool jaane se, aur 18 kN·m right hisse ka UDL resultant galti se free end par rakhne se (4 × 2 + 10).

questions.question: Simply supported beam AB, span 6 m, par triangular load hai jo A par 0 se badh kar B par 6 kN/m ho jaata hai (R_A = 6 kN, R_B = 12 kN). Maximum bending moment kitna hai?
questions.explanation: A se x par load intensity w = x kN/m (6 kN/m ÷ 6 m). Left hisse par load = x²/2, jiska centroid section se x/3 par hai. V = 6 − x²/2 = 0 ⇒ x = √12 = 3.46 m. M = 6x − (x²/2)(x/3) = 20.78 − 6.93 = 13.9 kN·m. 13.5 kN·m midspan (x = 3 m) ka moment hai — max beech me nahi, V = 0 par hai. 27.0 kN·m UDL wala wL²/8 hai. 20.8 kN·m load ka moment (x³/6) ghatana bhool jaane se aata hai.

weeks.title: Load–shear–moment relations and dry friction
weeks.summary: Is week aap beam ke chhote element se dV/dx = −w aur dM/dx = V derive karke SFD/BMD jaldi sketch karna, aur dry friction (static, kinetic, incline, ladder) ke basic problems solve karna seekhoge.
concepts: **Chhota element**: beam ka dx length ka tukda lo jispar w (per length, neeche positive) load hai. Left face par V upar aur M (sagging), right face par V + dV neeche aur M + dM. Beam continuous hai, to ye tukda bhi equilibrium me hai.
**dV/dx = −w**: element ka ΣFy: V − w·dx − (V + dV) = 0, to dV/dx = −w. Matlab SFD ka slope = load intensity ka negative. Integrate karo to V₂ − V₁ = −(do points ke beech load diagram ka area).
**dM/dx = V**: right face ke about moments: M + V·dx − w·dx·(dx/2) − (M + dM) = 0. dx² wala term chhota hai, to dM/dx = V. Matlab BMD ka slope = shear, aur M₂ − M₁ = do points ke beech SFD ka area.

**Turant sketch karne ke rules**: koi load nahi ⇒ V constant, M linear. UDL ⇒ V linear, M parabola. Point load ⇒ V me step, M me kink (slope badalta hai). Applied couple ⇒ V par koi asar nahi, M me utna hi step. Jahan V = 0, wahan M ka maximum ya minimum.

**Dry friction**: do surfaces ke beech friction F motion (ya motion ki tendency) ke opposite lagta hai. Static case me F ≤ μs·N — F utna hi hota hai jitna equilibrium ke liye chahiye. Motion shuru hone wali ho (impending) tab F = μs·N. Sliding ke dauraan F = μk·N, aur aam taur par μk < μs.
**Angle of friction aur incline**: tanφ = μs. Block incline par khud nahi fisalta jab tak tanθ ≤ μs, yaani θ ≤ φ. Ye result mass par depend nahi karta.

**Friction problem ka tareeka**: FBD banao, friction ki direction motion ki tendency ke ulta lo, pehle equilibrium maan kar required F nikalo, phir check karo F ≤ μs·N hai ya nahi. Ladder jaise problems me sabse pehle wo moment equation lo jo friction force ko N se jod de.

example.problem: Simply supported beam, span 6 m (A par pin x = 0, B par roller x = 6 m). x = 2 m par 12 kN aur x = 4 m par 6 kN, dono neeche. Area method (ΔM = SFD ka area) se BMD banao aur maximum moment nikalo.
steps: SFD: 0–2 m: V = +10. x = 2 par 12 kN ka step: 2–4 m: V = −2. x = 4 par 6 kN ka step: 4–6 m: V = −8. B par +8 reaction se V wapas 0 ✓.
M(4) = 20 + (−2)(2) = 16 kN·m. M(6) = 16 + (−8)(2) = 0 ✓ (roller par M zero hona chahiye).
V ka sign x = 2 m par + se − hota hai, to M max wahin hai. Har segment me V constant hai, to BMD seedhi lines se banega.
Answer: **M_max = 20 kN·m at x = 2 m**; BMD points (0, 0), (2, 20), (4, 16), (6, 0).

mistakes: Friction ko hamesha μs·N le lena. μs·N sirf maximum possible static friction hai; equilibrium me asli friction equations se nikalta hai aur kam bhi ho sakta hai.
dV/dx = −w ka sign bhool jaana. Neeche wala load shear ko ghatata hai, isliye UDL ke under SFD neeche ki taraf slope karta hai.
Applied couple par SFD me jump dikhana. Couple sirf BMD me jump deta hai; SFD me jump sirf point forces se aata hai.
revision: dV/dx = −w, dM/dx = V.
ΔV = −(load ka area), ΔM = (SFD ka area).
V = 0 ⇒ M extreme; couple ⇒ sirf M me jump.
Static: F ≤ μs·N; impending: F = μs·N; sliding: F = μk·N.
Incline par no slip jab tanθ ≤ μs.

questions.question: Beam ke kisi hisse par uniform distributed load (w constant) hai. Us hisse me SFD aur BMD ki shapes kaisi hongi?
questions.explanation: dV/dx = −w constant hai, to V linear (degree 1). dM/dx = V linear hai, to M ki degree 2, yaani parabola. 'V constant, M linear' wo hissa hai jahan koi load nahi. Har integration degree ek badha deta hai — yahi pattern yaad rakho.

questions.question: 10 kg ka block horizontal floor par rakha hai, μs = 0.4. Block ko bas hilana shuru karne ke liye kitni horizontal force chahiye? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: N = mg = 10 × 9.81 = 98.1 N. Impending motion par F = μs·N = 0.4 × 98.1 = 39.2 N. 4 N tab aata hai jab mass ko weight maan kar g bhool jaate ho (0.4 × 10). 98.1 N weight hai, friction nahi.

questions.question: 6 m span ke simply supported beam me shear V(x) = 12 − 4x kN hai (x metre me, 0 ≤ x ≤ 6) aur M(0) = 0. Maximum bending moment kitna hai?
questions.explanation: M(x) = ∫V dx = 12x − 2x². V = 0 at x = 3 m, to M_max = 12·3 − 2·9 = 36 − 18 = 18 kN·m. Ye SFD ke 0 se 3 m wale triangle ka area hai: ½ × 3 × 12 = 18. 36 kN·m tab aata hai jab −2x² wala term bhool jaate ho (12 × 3). 12 kN·m V(0) hai, moment nahi.

questions.question: Block aur incline ke beech μs = 0.3 hai. Incline ka maximum angle kya ho sakta hai jis par block bina push ke fisle bina ruka rahe?
questions.explanation: Fisalne ki shuruaat par mg sinθ = μs·mg cosθ, to tanθ = μs = 0.3, θ = tan⁻¹(0.3) = 16.7°. 17.5° sin⁻¹(0.3) se aata hai — galat function. 72.5° cos⁻¹(0.3) hai. Mass cancel ho jaata hai, isliye answer mass par depend nahi karta.

questions.question: Ek beam par x = 3 m par 10 kN·m ka clockwise couple laga hai (aur koi point force nahi). Is course ki sign convention (M = left forces ka clockwise moment, sagging +) me x = 3 m par diagrams me kya hoga?
options: V me 10 kN ka jump, M continuous
M me 10 kN·m ka upward jump, V par koi asar nahi
V aur M dono me 10 ka jump
Kuch nahi; couple sirf reactions ko affect karta hai
questions.explanation: Couple ki koi net force nahi hoti, to V continuous rehta hai. Section couple ke just right me ho to couple left hisse me aa jaata hai aur M me +10 kN·m (clockwise) jud jaata hai — isliye BMD me 10 kN·m ka upward step. SFD me jump dikhana sabse common galti hai; jump sirf point force se aata hai.

questions.question: Uniform ladder, weight 200 N, smooth (frictionless) vertical wall ke saath tika hai aur uska neeche wala end rough horizontal floor par hai. Ladder floor ke saath 60° banata hai. Ladder fisle nahi, iske liye floor par minimum μs kitna chahiye?
questions.explanation: Length L lo. Smooth wall sirf horizontal N_w deti hai. Floor par moments: N_w·L sin60° = 200·(L/2) cos60°, to N_w = 200/(2 tan60°) = 57.7 N. Floor: N = 200 N, friction F = N_w = 57.7 N. μs ≥ 57.7/200 = 0.289. 0.577 (= 1/tan60°) tab aata hai jab weight ko centre ki jagah top end par maan lete ho, yaani L/2 ka half bhool jaate ho.

questions.question: Load–shear relation ke hisaab se, beam ke kisi point par SFD ka slope dV/dx kisse barabar hai? (w = neeche ki taraf load intensity)
options: Us point ka bending moment M
questions.explanation: Chhote element ke ΣFy se dV/dx = −w: neeche wala load shear ko ghatata hai, isliye minus. "+w" sign bhool jaane ki galti hai. "V" wala relation BMD ke slope ka hai (dM/dx = V), SFD ka nahi, aur M ka SFD ke slope se seedha rishta nahi hai.

questions.question: 20 kg ka block horizontal floor par slide kar raha hai, μk = 0.25. Us par kinetic friction force kitni hai? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: N = mg = 20 × 9.81 = 196.2 N, F = μk·N = 0.25 × 196.2 = 49.1 N. 5.0 N g bhool kar mass ko hi N maan lene (0.25 × 20) se aata hai. 196.2 N normal reaction hai, friction nahi. 24.5 N me bina wajah ½ lag gaya.

questions.question: 10 kg ka block horizontal floor par hai, μs = 0.5. Arjun use 20 N ki horizontal force se dhakelta hai par block hilta nahi. Floor block par kitni friction force laga raha hai? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Block equilibrium me hai, to ΣFx = 0: friction = applied force = 20 N. μs·N = 0.5 × 98.1 = 49.1 N sirf maximum possible static friction hai — itni friction tabhi lagti jab block hilne hi wala ho. 98.1 N normal reaction hai. 0 N galat hai, kyunki friction na ho to 20 N block ko accelerate kar deti.

questions.question: Ek beam ka SFD: x = 0 se 3 m tak V = +8 kN, aur x = 3 m se 9 m tak V = −4 kN. M(0) = 0. x = 5 m par bending moment kitna hai?
questions.explanation: ΔM = SFD ka area. M(3) = 8 × 3 = 24 kN·m. M(5) = 24 + (−4)(2) = 16 kN·m (check: M(9) = 24 − 4 × 6 = 0). 24 kN·m x = 3 m ka (maximum) moment hai. 32 kN·m negative area ko bhi jod dene se aata hai (sign bhool kar). 8 kN·m sirf 3–5 m ka area hai, pehle ka 24 bhool kar.

questions.question: 5 kg ka block 30° incline par hai, μs = 0.3. Block ko neeche fisalne se rokne ke liye incline ke parallel (upar ki taraf) minimum kitni force chahiye? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: tan30° = 0.577 > 0.3, to bina force ke block fisalega. Fisalne ki tendency neeche hai, to friction upar: P + μs·mg cos30° = mg sin30°. P = 49.05(0.5 − 0.3 × 0.866) = 49.05 × 0.240 = 11.8 N. 37.3 N block ko upar dhakelna shuru karne ki force hai (friction ki direction ulti). 24.5 N friction bhool jaane se, aur 12.7 N max friction (μs·mg cos30°) khud hai.

questions.question: 20 kg ka crate horizontal floor par hai, μs = 0.4. Ek rope horizontal se 30° upar crate ko kheenchti hai. Crate ko bas hilane ke liye rope me kitni tension chahiye? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Rope ka upward component N ko kam karta hai: N = 196.2 − T sin30°. Impending motion: T cos30° = 0.4(196.2 − 0.5T) ⇒ T(0.866 + 0.2) = 78.48, T = 73.6 N. 78.5 N horizontal pull ka answer (μs·mg) hai. 90.6 N us 78.5 ko cos30° se divide karne se aata hai, N ka change bhool kar. 117.8 N tab aata hai jab T sin30° ko N me jod dete ho, jaise rope crate ko neeche dabaa rahi ho.

questions.question: 5 m lamba uniform ladder (weight 200 N) smooth vertical wall ke saath tika hai aur floor ke saath 60° banata hai. 600 N ka aadmi ladder par neeche wale end se 3 m (ladder ke along) upar khada hai. Ladder fisle nahi, iske liye floor par minimum μs kitna chahiye?
questions.explanation: Floor wale end ke about moments (smooth wall sirf horizontal N_w deti hai): N_w × 5 sin60° = 200 × 2.5 cos60° + 600 × 3 cos60° = 250 + 900 = 1150, to N_w = 265.6 N. Floor: N = 200 + 600 = 800 N, aur friction F = N_w. μs ≥ 265.6/800 = 0.332. 0.289 aadmi ko ignore karke sirf ladder ka answer hai. 0.505 aadmi ko top (5 m) par maan lene se aata hai. 1.33 tab aata hai jab N me sirf ladder ka weight (200 N) lete ho.

questions.question: Simply supported beam AB, span 6 m (A par pin, B par roller). Us par sirf ek 12 kN·m ka clockwise couple x = 2 m par laga hai, aur koi load nahi. Beam me maximum bending moment ka magnitude kitna hai, aur kahan?
questions.explanation: ΣM_A: R_B·6 − 12 = 0, R_B = 2 kN upar, R_A = 2 kN neeche. V = −2 kN poori beam me (couple V nahi badalta). Just left of x = 2: M = −2 × 2 = −4 kN·m. Clockwise couple M me +12 ka step deta hai, to just right M = +8 kN·m, phir B tak linearly 0 (8 − 2 × 4 = 0 ✓). |M|max = 8 kN·m. 4 kN·m left side ki value hai, jo chhoti hai. 12 kN·m step ka size hai, moment ka max nahi. 6 kN·m couple ko central point load jaisa treat karne se aata hai.

questions.question: Block A (4 kg) block B (6 kg) ke upar rakha hai. A ek horizontal string se wall se bandha hai, isliye wo hil nahi sakta. A–B ke beech μs = 0.3 aur B–floor ke beech μs = 0.2. B ko bas hilane ke liye B par kitni horizontal force P chahiye? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: B ke upar (A se) friction: 0.3 × 4 × 9.81 = 11.8 N. B ke neeche floor par normal = (4 + 6) × 9.81 = 98.1 N, to friction 0.2 × 98.1 = 19.6 N. Dono B ki motion ke opposite hain, to P = 11.8 + 19.6 = 31.4 N. 19.6 N A–B wali friction bhool jaane se aata hai. 23.5 N floor ka normal sirf B ke weight se lene (0.2 × 58.9 = 11.8) se. 41.2 N floor par bhi 0.3 laga dene se (29.4 + 11.8).

weeks.title: Work, potential energy and conservation of energy
weeks.summary: Is week aap force ka work, gravity aur spring ki potential energy, aur work–energy principle se speed, distance aur spring compression nikaalna seekhoge.
concepts: **Work**: force F agar displacement dr ke saath kaam kare to dU = F·dr. Constant force aur seedhi line me U = F·d·cosθ, jahan θ force aur displacement ke beech ka angle hai. Displacement ke perpendicular force (jaise normal reaction, ya circular motion me tension) koi work nahi karti.

**Gravity ka work aur potential energy**: weight ka work = −mg·Δh (upar jaane par negative). Gravitational potential energy Vg = mgh, jahan h kisi bhi chosen datum se upar ki height hai. Sirf height ka change matter karta hai, raasta nahi.

**Spring**: linear spring ki force F = kx (x = natural length se stretch ya compression). Spring energy Ve = ½kx². Spring ko x₁ se x₂ tak stretch karne me kiya gaya work = ½k(x₂² − x₁²) — ye ½k(x₂ − x₁)² ke barabar NAHI hai.
**Work–energy principle**: T₁ + U₁→₂ = T₂, jahan T = ½mv² (rigid body me rotation ka KE bhi, week 11 me). U₁→₂ me saari forces ka work aata hai, friction bhi.

**Conservation of energy**: agar sirf conservative forces (gravity, spring) work karti hain to T₁ + V₁ = T₂ + V₂, V = Vg + Ve. Friction non-conservative hai: kinetic friction ka work = −μk·N·d, jo heat me jaata hai.
**Power**: P = dU/dt = F·v. Efficiency = output power / input power. Unit watt (W) = J/s.

**Equilibrium aur stability (preview)**: ek degree of freedom q wale conservative system me equilibrium par dV/dq = 0. d²V/dq² > 0 ho to stable (V minimum), < 0 ho to unstable. Week 7 me isi idea ko virtual work se jodenge.

example.problem: 2 kg ka block ek vertical spring (k = 2000 N/m, shuru me natural length par) ke upar 0.5 m ki height se rest se chhoda jaata hai. Spring ka maximum compression kitna hoga? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
steps: Position 1: chhodte waqt, v = 0. Position 2: max compression x par, v phir 0. To T₁ = T₂ = 0.
Datum position 2 par lo. Block total (0.5 + x) neeche gira, to gravity PE ka loss = mg(0.5 + x) = 19.62(0.5 + x).
Spring energy ka gain = ½kx² = 1000x².
Quadratic formula: x = [19.62 + √(19.62² + 4·1000·9.81)]/2000 = (19.62 + 199.0)/2000 = 0.1093 m (negative root physically meaningless).
Answer: **maximum compression ≈ 0.109 m = 109 mm**.

mistakes: Spring par girne wale block me sirf h ka gravity work lena aur compression x ke dauraan hone wali extra girawat bhool jaana. Total drop h + x hai.
Spring work ke liye ½k(x₂ − x₁)² lagana. Sahi formula ½k(x₂² − x₁²) hai, kyunki spring energy x² ke saath badhti hai.
Friction ke work ko positive lena. Kinetic friction hamesha motion ke opposite hai, to uska work −μk·N·d hai.
revision: U = F·d·cosθ; perpendicular force ka work zero.
Vg = mgh, Ve = ½kx².
Spring work x₁ → x₂: ½k(x₂² − x₁²).
T₁ + U₁→₂ = T₂; sirf conservative forces: T₁ + V₁ = T₂ + V₂.
Friction loss = μk·N·d; P = F·v.

questions.question: Spring constant k = 400 N/m wali spring ko natural length se 0.05 m compress kiya gaya. Isme kitni elastic energy store hai?
questions.explanation: Ve = ½kx² = ½ × 400 × 0.05² = 0.5 J. 1.0 J tab aata hai jab ½ bhool jaate ho. 20 aur 10 to force (kx = 20 N) aur uska aadha hain, energy nahi.

questions.question: 3 kg ka box 2 m vertically upar uthaya gaya. Is dauraan gravity (box ke weight) ne kitna work kiya? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
options: 0, kyunki box rest se rest tak gaya
questions.explanation: Weight neeche hai aur displacement upar, to U = −mgΔh = −3 × 9.81 × 2 = −58.9 J. +58.9 J uthaane wale (aapke) dwara kiya gaya work hai, gravity ka nahi. Net work zero ho sakta hai, par sirf gravity ka work zero nahi.

questions.question: k = 500 N/m wali spring ko 0.1 m stretch se 0.3 m stretch tak kheencha gaya. Is dauraan spring ko stretch karne me kitna work laga?
questions.explanation: U = ½k(x₂² − x₁²) = ½ × 500 × (0.09 − 0.01) = 250 × 0.08 = 20 J. 10 J ½k(Δx)² = ½ × 500 × 0.2² lagane se aata hai — ye galat hai kyunki spring pehle se stretched thi. 22.5 J sirf final energy hai, initial 2.5 J ghatana bhool kar.

questions.question: Ek ball frictionless track par 5 m height se rest se chhodi jaati hai. Jab wo 1.8 m height wale point par pahunchti hai, uski speed kya hogi? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Energy conservation: ½v² = g(5 − 1.8) = 9.81 × 3.2, to v = √62.8 = 7.92 m/s. Track ka shape matter nahi karta, sirf height ka drop. 9.90 m/s poori 5 m ki height lene se aata hai, aur 5.94 m/s sirf 1.8 m lene se. 11.6 m/s heights ko jodne (6.8 m) se aata hai.

questions.question: 5 kg ka block horizontal floor par 6 m/s ki speed se sliding shuru karta hai, μk = 0.3. Rukne se pehle wo kitni doori tay karega? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Work–energy: ½mv² = μk·mg·d, to d = v²/(2μk·g) = 36/(2 × 0.3 × 9.81) = 6.12 m. Mass cancel ho jaata hai. 12.2 m ½ bhool jaane se aata hai, aur 60.0 m g bhool jaane se (36/0.6).

questions.question: 4 kg ka block ek vertical spring (k = 4000 N/m, natural length par) ke upar 0.2 m height se rest se chhoda gaya. Spring ka maximum compression kitna hoga? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Total drop = 0.2 + x. Energy: ½·4000·x² = 4·9.81·(0.2 + x), yaani 2000x² − 39.24x − 7.848 = 0. Positive root x = (39.24 + √(39.24² + 4·2000·7.848))/4000 = 0.0732 m = 73.2 mm. 62.6 mm tab aata hai jab compression ke dauraan ki girawat x bhool kar sirf mg·0.2 = ½kx² lete ho. 9.8 mm sirf static deflection mg/k hai.

questions.question: Ek trolley ko 50 N ki force se kheencha jaata hai jo displacement ke saath 60° banati hai. Trolley 4 m chalti hai. Is force ne kitna work kiya?
questions.explanation: U = F·d·cosθ = 50 × 4 × cos60° = 100 J. 200 J angle bhool jaane se aata hai. 173.2 J cos ki jagah sin lene se — sin wala component displacement ke perpendicular hai aur koi work nahi karta. 12.5 J force ko distance se divide karna hai.

questions.question: Ek motor cart ko 200 N ki constant force se 3 m/s ki constant speed par kheench raha hai (force aur velocity same direction me). Motor ki power output kitni hai?
questions.explanation: P = F·v = 200 × 3 = 600 W. 66.7 W, F ko v se divide karne se aata hai. 1800 W, v ko square karne (200 × 9) se. 200 W force ko hi power maan lena hai.

questions.question: Ek block horizontal floor par 5 m slide karta hai. Is dauraan floor ke normal reaction N ne kitna work kiya?
questions.explanation: Normal reaction vertical hai aur displacement horizontal — dono perpendicular, to U = N·d·cos90° = 0. "N × 5" force ko displacement se seedha multiply karna hai, direction dekhe bina, aur minus lagane se bhi angle wali baat theek nahi hoti. μk·N × 5 friction ka work (magnitude) hai, jo ek alag force hai.

questions.question: 2 kg ka pendulum bob 1.5 m lambi string se latka hai. String ko horizontal karke bob ko rest se chhoda jaata hai. Sabse neeche wale point par bob ki speed kya hogi? (g = 9.81 m/s², air resistance neglect)
questions.explanation: Tension hamesha velocity ke perpendicular hai, to wo koi work nahi karti; sirf gravity: ½v² = g × 1.5, v = √(2 × 9.81 × 1.5) = 5.42 m/s. 3.84 m/s, 2 bhool jaane (√(gL)) se aata hai. 29.4 square root lena bhoolne se (2gL = 29.4 m²/s²). 7.67 m/s drop ko 2L = 3 m maan lene se.

questions.question: k = 800 N/m wali spring 0.1 m compress ki gayi hai aur uske saamne 0.2 kg ki ball rakhi hai (frictionless horizontal surface). Spring chhodne par ball kis speed se nikalegi?
questions.explanation: ½kx² = ½mv², to spring energy 4 J aur v = x√(k/m) = 0.1 × √4000 = 6.32 m/s. 4.47 m/s tab aata hai jab ek taraf ½ lagao aur doosri taraf nahi (½kx² = mv²). 40.0 square root bhoolne se (v² = 40). 8.94 m/s spring energy ka ½ bhool kar (kx² = ½mv²) aata hai.

questions.question: 4 kg ka block 30° incline ke top se rest se chhoda jaata hai aur incline ke along 5 m slide karke neeche pahunchta hai. μk = 0.2. Neeche pahunchne par block ki speed kya hai? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Height drop = 5 sin30° = 2.5 m, to gravity ka work = 39.24 × 2.5 = 98.1 J. Friction = μk·mg cos30° = 0.2 × 39.24 × 0.866 = 6.80 N, uska work = −6.80 × 5 = −34.0 J. ½ × 4 × v² = 98.1 − 34.0 = 64.1 J, to v = 5.66 m/s. 7.00 m/s friction bhool jaane se. 5.42 m/s friction me cos30° bhool kar (N = mg) aata hai. 9.01 m/s incline ki 5 m length ko hi height maan lene se.

questions.question: 2 kg ka block frictionless 30° incline par rest se chhoda jaata hai. 1 m slide karne ke baad wo incline ke along rakhi ek spring (k = 1000 N/m, natural length par) se takraata hai. Spring ka maximum compression kitna hoga? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Incline ke along total travel 1 + x hai, to height drop (1 + x) sin30°. Energy: mg(1 + x) sin30° = ½kx² ⇒ 9.81(1 + x) = 500x², yaani 500x² − 9.81x − 9.81 = 0. Positive root: x = (9.81 + √(9.81² + 4 × 500 × 9.81))/1000 = 0.150 m = 150 mm. 140 mm compression ke dauraan ki extra girawat (x) bhool jaane se aata hai. 219 mm sin30° bhool kar poora mg lene se, aur 9.8 mm sirf static compression (mg sin30°/k) hai.

questions.question: 0.5 kg ka block rough horizontal floor (μk = 0.3) par hai aur ek spring (k = 300 N/m) se juda hai. Spring ko 0.1 m compress karke block ko rest se chhoda jaata hai. Jab spring natural length par pahunchti hai, block ki speed kya hai? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Spring energy = ½ × 300 × 0.1² = 1.5 J. Friction ka work = −μk·mg·d = −0.3 × 0.5 × 9.81 × 0.1 = −0.147 J. ½ × 0.5 × v² = 1.5 − 0.147 = 1.353 J, to v = 2.33 m/s. 2.45 m/s friction bhool jaane se. 2.57 m/s friction ka work positive (jod kar) lene se. 1.64 m/s KE ka ½ bhool jaane (mv² = 1.353) se aata hai.

questions.question: 1000 kg ki car 5° slope par 20 m/s ki constant speed se upar ja rahi hai. Rolling resistance aur air drag milakar 300 N hai (motion ke opposite). Engine ko wheels par kitni power deni padegi? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Speed constant hai, to driving force = mg sin5° + 300 = 9810 × 0.0872 + 300 = 855 + 300 = 1155 N. P = F·v = 1155 × 20 = 23.1 kW. 6.0 kW sirf resistance (300 × 20) hai, slope bhool kar. 17.1 kW sirf gravity wala hissa hai. 202 kW sin5° ki jagah poora weight (9810 N) le lene se aata hai.

weeks.title: Virtual work for linkages and mechanisms
weeks.summary: Is week aap principle of virtual work se mechanisms aur linkages me equilibrium forces nikalna seekhoge, bina har joint ke internal reactions solve kiye, aur potential energy se stability check karna.
concepts: **Virtual displacement**: ek imaginary, bahut chhota displacement δq jo constraints ko respect karta hai (pin ke around rotation, roller ke along slide). Ye asli motion nahi hai — bas equilibrium test karne ka ek soch ka tool hai, isliye time nahi lagta.
**Virtual work**: δU = Σ F·δr + Σ M·δθ. Force ka work = force × uski direction me point ka virtual displacement; couple ka work = M × virtual rotation.

**Principle of virtual work**: ideal system (smooth pins, rollers, inextensible links) equilibrium me hai agar aur sirf agar har compatible virtual displacement ke liye δU = 0. Ideal constraints ki reactions koi virtual work nahi karti, isliye wo equation me aati hi nahi — yahi is method ki taakat hai.

**Degree of freedom aur coordinates**: ek DOF mechanism (jaise scissor ya slider-crank) me sab positions ek hi coordinate θ se likh sakte ho. Har load point ki position θ me likho (jaise y = L sinθ), phir differentiate karo: δy = L cosθ·δθ. Sign dhyaan se: δx negative ho to point peeche jaata hai.

**Tareeka**: (1) ek fixed origin aur axes chuno, (2) har force ke point ki coordinate (force ki direction me) θ me likho, (3) δ lo, (4) δU = Σ F·δ(coordinate) = 0 likho aur δθ cancel karo. Agar kisi support ki reaction chahiye, to us constraint ko hata kar uski jagah unknown force lagao, taaki wo point move kar sake.

**Potential energy form**: agar saari forces conservative hain (weight, spring) to δU = −δV, aur equilibrium par dV/dθ = 0. d²V/dθ² > 0 ⇒ stable, < 0 ⇒ unstable, = 0 ⇒ aage check karna padega (neutral ho sakta hai).

**Mechanical advantage**: lever ya linkage me load/effort ratio virtual work se seedha milta hai: effort × apna virtual displacement = load × apna virtual displacement. Jaise lever me P·a·δθ = W·b·δθ, to P = W·b/a.

example.problem: Do bars AB aur BC, har ek length L, B par hinged hain. A floor par pinned hai, C floor par roller par hai. Dono bars floor se θ angle banati hain. B par vertical load P = 100 N neeche hai. C par horizontal force Q (A ki taraf) lagao taaki θ = 30° par equilibrium rahe. Bars ka weight neglect. Q nikalo.
steps: Origin A par lo, x right, y upar. B ki height y_B = L sinθ, C ki position x_C = 2L cosθ.
Virtual displacements: δy_B = L cosθ·δθ, δx_C = −2L sinθ·δθ.
P neeche hai, to uska work = −P·δy_B. Q, A ki taraf (−x) hai, to uska work = −Q·δx_C. Pin A aur roller C ki reactions ka koi work nahi.
δU = −P·L cosθ·δθ + Q·2L sinθ·δθ = 0.
δθ ≠ 0, to Q = P cosθ/(2 sinθ) = P/(2 tanθ).
Answer: **Q = 86.6 N** (A ki taraf). Dhyaan do, hinge B ki internal force kabhi nikaalni hi nahi padi.
example.code:
↓ P = 100 N
    B
   / \
  /   \
 /     \
A       C ← Q
^       o

AB = BC = L, both at θ to the floor
^ = pin, o = roller

mistakes: Virtual displacement ka sign galat lena. Jab θ badhta hai to x_C = 2L cosθ ghatata hai, isliye δx_C negative hai; sign bhoolne par force ki direction ulti aa jaati hai.
Pin aur roller reactions ko bhi virtual work equation me daal dena. Ideal constraints ka virtual work zero hai; agar reaction chahiye to constraint release karo.
Coordinate force ki line ke along naa lena. Vertical force ke liye y coordinate ka δ chahiye, x ka nahi.
revision: Equilibrium ⇔ δU = 0 har compatible δq ke liye.
Ideal constraints ki reactions: zero virtual work.
Position θ me likho, differentiate: δy = (dy/dθ)·δθ.
Conservative: dV/dθ = 0; d²V/dθ² > 0 stable.
Scissor linkage: Q = P/(2 tanθ).

questions.question: Ideal mechanism (smooth pins, rollers, rigid inextensible links) par principle of virtual work lagate waqt kin forces ka virtual work automatically zero hota hai?
options: Smooth pins aur rollers ki reactions ka
questions.explanation: Smooth pin ki reaction aise point par lagti hai jo move nahi karta, aur roller ki reaction movement ke perpendicular hoti hai — dono ka virtual work zero. Isiliye ye method unhe bina solve kiye skip kar deta hai. Friction non-ideal hai: sliding ke saath wo work karta hai, isliye use alag se daalna padta hai.

questions.question: Ek lever fulcrum O par pivoted hai. Effort P, O se 1.2 m par aur 800 N ka load O ke doosri taraf 0.3 m par hai (dono forces lever ke perpendicular). Virtual rotation δθ lekar equilibrium ke liye P nikalo.
questions.explanation: Virtual rotation δθ par effort ka point 1.2·δθ aur load ka point 0.3·δθ move karta hai. δU = P·1.2·δθ − 800·0.3·δθ = 0, to P = 240/1.2 = 200 N. 3200 N tab aata hai jab arms ulte laga dete ho (800 × 1.2/0.3). Lambi effort arm force kam karti hai, badhati nahi.

questions.question: Scissor linkage: bars AB = BC = L, B par hinged, A floor par pinned, C floor par roller par, dono bars floor se θ = 45° par. B par 200 N ka vertical load neeche. C par kitni horizontal force Q (A ki taraf) equilibrium rakhegi?
questions.explanation: y_B = L sinθ, x_C = 2L cosθ. δU = −200·L cosθ·δθ + Q·2L sinθ·δθ = 0, to Q = 200/(2 tanθ) = 200/2 = 100 N. 200 N tab aata hai jab x_C = 2L cosθ wala 2 bhool kar x_C = L cosθ le lete ho. 141.4 N = 200/√2, bas load ka component lene se.

questions.question: Ek linkage me slider ki position x = 2L cosθ hai, jahan L = 0.5 m. θ = 30° par virtual rotation δθ = 0.01 rad diya jaaye to slider ka virtual displacement δx kitna hoga?
questions.explanation: δx = (dx/dθ)·δθ = −2L sinθ·δθ = −2 × 0.5 × 0.5 × 0.01 = −0.005 m. Minus ka matlab: θ badhne par slider origin ki taraf aata hai. −0.00866 m tab aata hai jab d(cosθ)/dθ ko −sinθ ki jagah −cosθ le lete ho, aur +0.005 m minus sign bhoolne se.

questions.question: Ek conservative system ki potential energy V(x) = 2x³ − 6x joule hai (x metre me). Equilibrium positions aur unki stability ke baare me kya sahi hai?
questions.explanation: dV/dx = 6x² − 6 = 0 ⇒ x = ±1. d²V/dx² = 12x: x = 1 par +12 > 0 (V minimum, stable), x = −1 par −12 < 0 (V maximum, unstable). Ulta answer tab aata hai jab yaad rakhte ho 'V'' negative = stable' — asal me minimum (positive curvature) stable hota hai, jaise katori ke tale me ball. x = 0 par dV/dx = −6 ≠ 0, to wo equilibrium nahi.

questions.question: Scissor linkage: AB = BC = 0.5 m, A floor par pinned, C floor par roller par, B par 100 N vertical load neeche. Force Q ki jagah ek horizontal spring A aur C ko jodti hai; spring ki natural length 0.5 m hai (jo θ = 60° par AC hai). θ = 30° par equilibrium ke liye spring constant k kitna chahiye? (bars weightless)
questions.explanation: Virtual work se spring ko C par Q = P/(2 tanθ) = 100/(2 tan30°) = 86.6 N ki pull deni hogi. θ = 30° par AC = 2 × 0.5 × cos30° = 0.866 m, to stretch = 0.866 − 0.5 = 0.366 m. k = 86.6/0.366 = 237 N/m. 473 N/m tab aata hai jab x_C me 2 bhool kar Q = P/tanθ lete ho. 100 N/m tab aata hai jab stretch ki jagah poori length 0.866 m se divide karte ho.

questions.question: Principle of virtual work me "virtual displacement" kya hai?
options: Body ka asli displacement jo kuch time me hota hai, loads ke kaaran
Sirf ek virtual rotation; translation is method me allowed nahi
Load ki direction me ek bada, finite displacement
questions.explanation: Virtual displacement δq ek soch ka tool hai: imaginary, infinitesimal, aur constraints ko respect karta hai (pin ke around rotation, roller ke along slide). Ye asli motion nahi hai, isliye time nahi lagta. Translation aur rotation dono ho sakte hain. "Bada, finite" displacement galat hai, kyunki tab geometry hi badal jaati.

questions.question: Ek body par M = 50 N·m ka couple laga hai aur body couple ke hi sense me δθ = 0.02 rad ka virtual rotation karti hai. Couple ka virtual work kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Couple ka virtual work = M·δθ = 50 × 0.02 = 1.0 J (N·m × rad = J). 2500 J δθ se divide karne se aata hai. 0 J galat hai — couple ki net force zero hai, par rotation par wo work karta hai. 0.5 J me bina wajah ½ lag gaya, jaise spring energy me hota hai.

questions.question: Ek conservative system ki potential energy V(q) = 5q² − 20q joule hai. Equilibrium position aur uski stability kya hai?
questions.explanation: dV/dq = 10q − 20 = 0 ⇒ q = 2. d²V/dq² = 10 > 0, to V minimum hai aur equilibrium stable. q = 4 tab aata hai jab V = 0 rakh dete ho (5q² = 20q) — equilibrium dV/dq = 0 se milta hai, V = 0 se nahi. q = 0 par dV/dq = −20 ≠ 0. Positive curvature = stable, isliye "unstable" galat hai.

questions.question: Ek linkage me load point ki height y = L sinθ hai, jahan L = 0.8 m. θ = 60° par virtual rotation δθ = 0.02 rad ho to δy kitna hai?
questions.explanation: δy = (dy/dθ)·δθ = L cosθ·δθ = 0.8 × 0.5 × 0.02 = 0.008 m. 0.0139 m tab aata hai jab derivative me cos ki jagah sin rakh dete ho. −0.008 m galat hai: sin ka derivative +cos hai, minus cos ke derivative me aata hai. 0.016 m cos60° bhool jaane se.

questions.question: Scissor linkage: bars AB = BC = L, B par hinged, A floor par pinned, C floor par roller par. Dono bars floor se θ = 60° par hain. B par 240 N vertical load neeche hai. C par kitni horizontal force Q (A ki taraf) equilibrium rakhegi? (bars weightless)
questions.explanation: y_B = L sinθ, x_C = 2L cosθ. δU = −240·L cosθ·δθ + Q·2L sinθ·δθ = 0 ⇒ Q = 240/(2 tan60°) = 240/3.464 = 69.3 N. 207.8 N tan ko numerator me rakhne (P tanθ/2) se aata hai. 138.6 N x_C ka 2 bhool jaane (P/tanθ) se. 120 N sirf P/2 hai, angle ignore karke.

questions.question: 2 m lambi uniform bar AB (weight 50 N) ka neeche wala end A floor par pinned hai. Bar floor se θ = 30° par hai, aur top end B par ek horizontal force P (A wali vertical line ki taraf) bar ko girne se rokti hai. Virtual work se P nikalo. (koi friction nahi)
questions.explanation: Origin A par lo. Weight G par lagta hai: y_G = 1·sinθ, to δy_G = cosθ·δθ. B: x_B = 2 cosθ, δx_B = −2 sinθ·δθ. P −x direction me hai, to uska work = −P·δx_B = 2P sinθ·δθ. δU = −50 cosθ·δθ + 2P sinθ·δθ = 0 ⇒ P = 50/(2 tan30°) = 43.3 N. 86.6 N weight ko G ki jagah B par (y = 2 sinθ) maan lene se aata hai. 14.4 N tan ko ulta lagane (25 tan30°) se. 25.0 N angle ignore karke W/2 hai.

questions.question: Ek light rod (length L = 0.5 m) ke top par 2 kg ka mass hai, aur rod neeche ek pin par torsional spring (stiffness k, N·m/rad) se judi hai. Vertical se angle θ par V(θ) = ½kθ² + mgL cosθ. Vertical position (θ = 0) stable rahe, iske liye k kitna hona chahiye? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: dV/dθ = kθ − mgL sinθ, jo θ = 0 par zero hai, to ye equilibrium hai. d²V/dθ² = k − mgL cosθ; θ = 0 par k − mgL > 0 chahiye, yaani k > 2 × 9.81 × 0.5 = 9.81 N·m/rad. 19.62 tab aata hai jab L bhool kar sirf mg lete ho. 4.905 bina wajah ½ lagane se. "Kisi bhi k" galat hai: k kam ho to −mgL wala term V ko maximum bana deta hai (unstable).

questions.question: Scissor linkage: bars AB = BC = L, har bar ka weight 80 N (uniform), A floor par pinned, C smooth floor par roller par, aur B par hinge. Dono bars floor se θ = 45° par hain, aur koi aur load nahi. C par kitni horizontal force Q (A ki taraf) equilibrium rakhegi?
questions.explanation: Har bar ka centre (L/2) sinθ height par hai, to har weight ka virtual work = −80·(L/2) cosθ·δθ. x_C = 2L cosθ. δU = −2 × 80 × (L/2) cosθ·δθ + Q·2L sinθ·δθ = 0 ⇒ Q = 80/(2 tanθ) = 40 N (θ = 45°). 80 N tab aata hai jab dono weights ko B par (height L sinθ) maan lete ho. 20 N sirf ek bar ka weight ginne se. 56.6 N bas weight ka cos45° component lene se aata hai.

questions.question: Uniform crank OA (length 0.6 m, weight 40 N) point O par pinned hai aur horizontal se θ = 60° upar hai. End A par 200 N ki vertical force neeche lagi hai. Crank ko is position me rokne ke liye O par kitna couple M (θ badhane wali direction me) chahiye?
questions.explanation: y_A = 0.6 sinθ, y_G = 0.3 sinθ. δU = M·δθ − 200 × 0.6 cosθ·δθ − 40 × 0.3 cosθ·δθ = 0 ⇒ M = (120 + 12) cos60° = 66.0 N·m. 60.0 N·m crank ka apna weight bhool jaane se aata hai. 114.3 N·m cos ki jagah sin (132 × 0.866) lene se. 72.0 N·m crank ke weight ko G ki jagah A par maan lene se ((200 + 40) × 0.6 × 0.5).

weeks.title: Particle dynamics in three coordinate systems
weeks.summary: Is week aap Newton ka second law rectangular, normal-tangential aur polar (cylindrical) coordinates me lagana seekhoge, taaki seedhi line, curve aur ghoomti rod — teeno tarah ki motion solve kar sako.
concepts: **Newton's second law**: ΣF = m·a, jahan a absolute (non-accelerating frame se naapa gaya) acceleration hai. Har problem me do diagrams banao: FBD (saari forces) aur kinetic diagram (m·a ke components). Phir component-wise barabar karo.
**Rectangular coordinates (x, y)**: ΣFx = m·ẍ, ΣFy = m·ÿ. Seedhi line ki motion, inclines aur projectiles ke liye best. Projectile me (air resistance ke bina) ẍ = 0 aur ÿ = −g.

**Normal-tangential (n-t) coordinates**: jab path pata ho (curve, loop, banked road). a_t = dv/dt (speed ka change, path ke along) aur a_n = v²/ρ (hamesha centre of curvature ki taraf). Speed constant ho tab bhi a_n zero nahi hota.

**Polar coordinates (r, θ)**: jab cheez ek ghoomti line ke along chal rahi ho (rod par bead, radar tracking). v_r = ṙ, v_θ = r·θ̇. a_r = r̈ − r·θ̇², a_θ = r·θ̈ + 2·ṙ·θ̇. 3D me z axis jod do (cylindrical): a_z = z̈.
