**2ṙθ̇ term**: a_θ ka ye hissa tab bhi hota hai jab θ̈ = 0 ho, agar particle radially move karte hue ghoom raha hai. Ise bhoolna is topic ki sabse badi galti hai — ye wahi Coriolis effect hai jo week 10 me aayega.

**Friction aur banking**: unbanked curve par friction hi centripetal force deta hai: μs·mg ≥ mv²/r, to v_max = √(μs·g·r). Bina friction ke banked road par tanθ = v²/(g·r) wali speed par car na upar fisalti hai na neeche.

**Connected bodies**: string se jude blocks ki acceleration magnitude same hoti hai (inextensible string). Har block ka alag FBD banao, tension T dono me same rakho (light string, smooth pulley), phir equations solve karo.

example.problem: 1200 kg ki car ek unbanked (flat) circular road par chal rahi hai jiska radius 50 m hai. Tyres aur road ke beech μs = 0.6. Car bina skid kiye maximum kitni speed se mod le sakti hai? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
steps: n-t axes lo: n centre ki taraf, vertical alag se.
Vertical: N − mg = 0, to N = mg.
Normal direction: sirf friction centre ki taraf hai: F = m·v²/r.
Skid ki limit par F = μs·N = μs·m·g. To μs·m·g = m·v²/r.
Answer: **v_max ≈ 17.2 m/s (≈ 62 km/h)**, car ke mass par depend nahi karta.

mistakes: Constant speed ka matlab zero acceleration samajhna. Curve par speed constant ho tab bhi a_n = v²/ρ centre ki taraf hota hai.
Polar coordinates me a_θ ka 2ṙθ̇ term ya a_r ka −rθ̇² term bhool jaana. Dono terms tab bhi hote hain jab r̈ = θ̈ = 0 ho.
Connected blocks me tension ko hanging block ke weight ke barabar maan lena. Block accelerate kar raha hai, to T = m(g − a), weight se kam.
revision: ΣF = m·a; FBD + kinetic diagram.
n-t: a_t = dv/dt, a_n = v²/ρ.
Polar: a_r = r̈ − rθ̇², a_θ = rθ̈ + 2ṙθ̇.
Flat curve: v_max = √(μs·g·r).
Frictionless banking: tanθ = v²/(g·r).

questions.question: 20 kg ka crate horizontal floor par 100 N ki horizontal force se kheencha jaata hai. μk = 0.2. Crate ki acceleration kya hai? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Friction = μk·mg = 0.2 × 20 × 9.81 = 39.24 N. a = (100 − 39.24)/20 = 3.04 m/s². 5.00 m/s² friction bhool jaane se aata hai, aur 6.96 m/s² friction ko force ke saath jod dene se — friction motion ke opposite hota hai.

questions.question: Ek car 80 m radius wale curve par 20 m/s ki constant speed se chal rahi hai. Uski normal (centripetal) acceleration kitni hai?
questions.explanation: a_n = v²/ρ = 20²/80 = 400/80 = 5 m/s². Speed constant hai to a_t = 0, par a_n zero nahi. 0.25 m/s² v/ρ lene se aata hai (square bhool kar), aur 4 m/s² ρ/v se.

questions.question: Ek car 75 m radius ke curve par hai. Is pal uski speed 15 m/s hai aur wo 3 m/s² ki rate se speed badha rahi hai. Total acceleration ka magnitude kya hai?
questions.explanation: a_t = 3 m/s², a_n = 15²/75 = 3 m/s². Dono perpendicular hain, to |a| = √(3² + 3²) = √18 = 4.24 m/s². 6.00 m/s² dono ko seedha jodne se aata hai (vector nahi), aur 18.0 square root lena bhoolne se. 3.00 sirf ek component hai.

questions.question: Ek bead ghoomti rod ke along slide kar raha hai. Is pal r = 0.5 m, ṙ = 0.2 m/s, r̈ = 0, θ̇ = 4 rad/s aur θ̈ = 0. Transverse acceleration a_θ kitna hai?
questions.explanation: a_θ = r·θ̈ + 2·ṙ·θ̇ = 0.5 × 0 + 2 × 0.2 × 4 = 1.6 m/s². θ̈ = 0 hone par bhi 2ṙθ̇ term bachta hai — '0' wahi trap hai. 0.8 m/s² 2 bhool jaane se aata hai, aur 2.0 m/s² to v_θ = rθ̇ hai, acceleration nahi.

questions.question: 100 m radius ki road ko kis angle par bank karna chahiye taaki 25 m/s ki speed par car ko friction ki zaroorat bilkul na pade? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Bina friction: N sinθ = mv²/r aur N cosθ = mg, to tanθ = v²/(g·r) = 625/981 = 0.637, θ = 32.5°. 39.6° sin⁻¹(0.637) se aata hai — galat function. 57.5° complement hai, jo angle vertical se naapne par aata hai. 14.0° tan⁻¹(v/r) hai, jisme v ka square aur g dono gayab hain.

questions.question: Block A (6 kg) horizontal table par hai (μk = 0.2) aur ek light string se juda hai jo table ke kinare par smooth pulley ke upar se jaakar hanging block B (4 kg) se judti hai. System chhodne par string me tension kitni hogi? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Poore system ke liye: a = (4·9.81 − 0.2·6·9.81)/(6 + 4) = (39.24 − 11.77)/10 = 2.75 m/s². Block B: 4·9.81 − T = 4a, to T = 4(9.81 − 2.75) = 28.3 N (check A se: T = 6a + 11.77 = 28.3 ✓). 39.2 N B ka weight hai — block accelerate kar raha hai, to T weight se kam hai. 23.5 N friction bhool jaane se aata hai.

questions.question: 1500 kg ki car par 6000 N ki net braking force lagti hai. Uska deceleration kitna hai?
questions.explanation: ΣF = m·a ⇒ a = 6000/1500 = 4.00 m/s². 0.25 m/s² ulta divide (m/F) karne se aata hai. 40.0 m/s² decimal galat jagah lagane ki galti hai. 9.81 m/s² to g hai, jiska is horizontal motion me koi role nahi.

questions.question: Ek ball 20 m oonchi building se horizontally phenki jaati hai. Ground tak pahunchne me kitna time lagega? (g = 9.81 m/s², air resistance neglect)
questions.explanation: Vertical me initial velocity zero hai (horizontal throw): 20 = ½ × 9.81 × t², t = √(40/9.81) = 2.02 s. Horizontal speed is time ko affect nahi karti. 4.08 s square root bhool jaane se (t² = 4.08). 1.43 s ½ bhool kar h = g·t² lene se, aur 1.01 s formula ulta karke √(h/2g) lene se.

questions.question: Ek bead ghoomti rod par r = 2 m par ruka hua hai (ṙ = 0), aur rod θ̇ = 3 rad/s se ghoom rahi hai. Bead ki transverse velocity v_θ kitni hai?
questions.explanation: v_θ = r·θ̇ = 2 × 3 = 6 m/s. 0 m/s galat hai: ṙ = 0 sirf radial velocity ko zero karta hai. 18 m/s = rθ̇², jo centripetal acceleration (m/s²) hai, velocity nahi. 1.5 m/s, r/θ̇ hai.

questions.question: 70 kg ka aadmi ek lift me weighing scale par khada hai. Lift 2 m/s² se upar accelerate kar rahi hai. Scale kitni reading (normal force) dikhayega? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: ΣFy = m·a: N − mg = m·a, to N = 70(9.81 + 2) = 827 N. 687 N sirf weight hai (a = 0 maan kar). 547 N acceleration ko neeche maan lene (9.81 − 2) se aata hai. 140 N sirf m·a hai, weight bhool kar.

questions.question: Ek roller-coaster car 10 m radius wale vertical loop ke top par hai. Top par track se contact na chhoote, iske liye minimum speed kitni honi chahiye? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Top par N aur mg dono neeche (centre ki taraf) hain: N + mg = mv²/r. Minimum speed par N = 0, to v = √(g·r) = √98.1 = 9.90 m/s. 14.0 m/s = √(2gr), jo energy wale formula se mix-up hai. 98.1 square root bhoolne (v² = 98.1) se aata hai. 4.95 m/s bina wajah half karna hai.

questions.question: Ek slider ghoomti arm ke along chal raha hai. Is pal r = 0.4 m, ṙ = 0.5 m/s, r̈ = 0.2 m/s², θ̇ = 3 rad/s aur θ̈ = 1 rad/s². Slider ki total acceleration ka magnitude kya hai?
questions.explanation: a_r = r̈ − r·θ̇² = 0.2 − 0.4 × 9 = −3.4 m/s². a_θ = r·θ̈ + 2ṙθ̇ = 0.4 + 2 × 0.5 × 3 = 3.4 m/s². |a| = √(3.4² + 3.4²) = 4.81 m/s². 3.89 m/s² 2ṙθ̇ ka factor 2 bhool jaane (a_θ = 1.9) se aata hai. 6.80 m/s² perpendicular components ko seedha jodne se. 5.10 m/s² −rθ̇² ko + lene (a_r = 3.8) se.

questions.question: 60 m radius ki road 20° par banked hai, aur tyres–road ke beech μs = 0.3. Car bina upar ki taraf fisle maximum kitni speed se mod le sakti hai? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Max speed par friction slope ke neeche (centre ki taraf) lagta hai. Vertical: N cos20° − μN sin20° = mg. Horizontal: N sin20° + μN cos20° = mv²/r. Divide karke v² = g·r(sin20° + μ cos20°)/(cos20° − μ sin20°) = 588.6 × 0.624/0.837 = 438.7, to v = 20.9 m/s. 14.6 m/s bina friction wali (tanθ) speed hai. 13.3 m/s flat road ka √(μgr) hai, banking bhool kar. 19.8 m/s tanθ aur μ ko seedha jodne (√(gr(tanθ + μ))) se aata hai.

questions.question: Block A (5 kg) frictionless 30° incline par hai aur ek light string se juda hai jo incline ke top par smooth pulley ke upar se hanging block B (4 kg) tak jaati hai. Chhodne par system ki acceleration kitni hai? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Driving force = B ka weight − A ke weight ka slope ke along component = 4 × 9.81 − 5 × 9.81 × sin30° = 39.24 − 24.53 = 14.72 N. a = 14.72/(5 + 4) = 1.64 m/s² (B neeche, A upar). 4.36 m/s² A ka slope component bhool jaane (39.24/9) se aata hai. 2.94 m/s² sirf A ke mass se divide karne se. 1.09 m/s² sin30° bhool kar A ka poora weight lene se (aur tab direction bhi ulti aati hai).

questions.question: Ek ball ground se 20 m/s ki speed par horizontal se 45° par phenki jaati hai. Launch point se 30 m door ek wall hai. Wall tak pahunchne par ball ki height kitni hogi? (g = 9.81 m/s², air resistance neglect)
questions.explanation: v_x = v_y0 = 20 cos45° = 14.14 m/s. Wall tak time t = 30/14.14 = 2.12 s. y = 14.14 × 2.12 − ½ × 9.81 × 2.12² = 30.0 − 22.1 = 7.93 m. 30.0 m gravity bhool jaane se aata hai. 22.1 m sirf gravity ki wajah se girawat hai. 10.2 m horizontal speed me cos45° bhool kar (v_x = 20, t = 1.5 s) aata hai.

weeks.title: Central force motion and orbits
weeks.summary: Is week aap central force me angular momentum conservation, circular aur elliptical orbits ke basic results, aur satellites jaise engineering applications me speed aur period nikalna seekhoge.
concepts: **Central force**: aisi force jo hamesha ek fixed point O ki taraf (ya usse door) hoti hai, jaise planet par Sun ki gravity ya satellite par Earth ki. Polar coordinates me iska transverse component zero hai: F_θ = 0.

**Angular momentum conservation**: F_θ = m·a_θ = 0 aur a_θ = (1/r)·d(r²θ̇)/dt, to h = r²θ̇ = constant. Isi ko h = r·v⊥ bhi likhte hain (v⊥ = velocity ka radius ke perpendicular component). Perigee aur apogee par velocity radius ke perpendicular hoti hai, to r_p·v_p = r_a·v_a.
**Kepler ka second law**: radius vector barabar time me barabar area sweep karta hai, kyunki dA/dt = h/2 constant hai. Isliye satellite paas (perigee) par tez aur door (apogee) par dheema chalta hai.
**Gravity**: F = G·M·m/r². Earth ke liye GM = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s² (ya GM = g·R², R ≈ 6371 km). Force r² se ghatati hai, isliye 'g' height ke saath kam hota hai.
**Circular orbit**: gravity hi centripetal force: GMm/r² = mv²/r, to v = √(GM/r) aur period T = 2πr/v = 2π√(r³/GM). T² ∝ r³ (Kepler ka third law). Escape speed v_esc = √(2GM/r) = √2 × circular speed.

**Elliptical orbit (intro)**: semi-major axis a = (r_p + r_a)/2. Speed kisi bhi point par vis-viva equation se: v² = GM(2/r − 1/a). Circular orbit me r = a, to wapas v² = GM/r. Total energy E = −GMm/(2a) — sirf a par depend karti hai.

**Engineering applications**: low Earth orbit (~400 km altitude, period ~92 min), geostationary orbit (period 1 sidereal day, r ≈ 42,164 km, equator ke upar ek jagah 'ruka' dikhta hai), aur Hohmann transfer: do circular orbits ke beech ek ellipse jo andar wale orbit ko perigee aur bahar wale ko apogee par chhooti hai.

example.problem: Ek satellite Earth ki surface se 400 km upar circular orbit me hai. Uski orbital speed aur period nikalo. (GM = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s², Earth radius R = 6371 km)
steps: Orbit radius centre se naapo, surface se nahi: r = 6371 + 400 = 6771 km = 6.771 × 10⁶ m.
Minutes me: 5545/60 = 92.4 min.
Answer: **v ≈ 7.67 km/s, T ≈ 92.4 min** — space station jaise LEO satellites din me lagbhag 15–16 chakkar lagate hain.

mistakes: Orbit radius me sirf altitude le lena. r hamesha Earth ke centre se hota hai: r = R + h.
Elliptical orbit me perigee aur apogee par same speed maan lena. h = r·v constant hai, to paas wale point par speed zyada hai.
Escape speed ka 11.2 km/s har height par use kar dena. Ye sirf Earth ki surface ke liye hai; kisi bhi r par v_esc = √(2GM/r).
revision: Central force ⇒ h = r²θ̇ = r·v⊥ constant.
Perigee/apogee: r_p·v_p = r_a·v_a.
Circular: v = √(GM/r), T = 2π√(r³/GM).
v_esc = √2 × v_circular (same r).
Vis-viva: v² = GM(2/r − 1/a), a = (r_p + r_a)/2.

questions.question: Ek satellite elliptical orbit me hai. Perigee par uski distance (Earth ke centre se) 7000 km aur speed 8 km/s hai. Apogee 14000 km par hai. Apogee par speed kya hogi?
questions.explanation: Perigee aur apogee par velocity radius ke perpendicular hoti hai, to angular momentum se r_p·v_p = r_a·v_a: v_a = 7000 × 8/14000 = 4 km/s. 16 km/s ratio ulta lagane se aata hai — door wale point par speed kam hoti hai. 5.66 km/s (= 8/√2) tab aata hai jab circular orbit wala √(1/r) scaling laga dete ho.

questions.question: Ek particle par sirf ek central force lagti hai jo hamesha fixed point O ki taraf hai. Kaunsi quantity O ke about zaroor conserve hogi?
questions.explanation: Central force ka O ke about moment zero hai (force O se guzarti hai), to angular momentum H_O = m·r²θ̇ constant rehta hai. Linear momentum conserve nahi hota kyunki net force zero nahi hai. Speed bhi elliptical orbit me badalti hai — sirf circular orbit me constant hoti hai.

questions.question: Earth ke centre se 8000 km radius wale circular orbit me satellite ki speed kya hai? (GM = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s²)
questions.explanation: v = √(GM/r) = √(3.986 × 10¹⁴ / 8 × 10⁶) = √(4.98 × 10⁷) = 7059 m/s ≈ 7.06 km/s. 9.98 km/s is radius ki escape speed √(2GM/r) hai. 49.8 tab aata hai jab square root lena bhool jaate ho (GM/r = 49.8 km²/s²).

questions.question: Ek satellite ka circular orbit radius 4 guna kar diya jaaye (same planet). Uska orbital period kitne guna ho jaayega?
questions.explanation: T = 2π√(r³/GM), to T ∝ r^(3/2). r × 4 ⇒ T × 4^(3/2) = 8 guna. 4 guna T ∝ r maan kar aata hai, 16 guna T ∝ r² maan kar, aur 2 guna T ∝ √r maan kar. Kepler ka third law T² ∝ r³ yaad rakho.

questions.question: Ek radius r par circular orbit ki speed 7.5 km/s hai. Usi radius se escape speed kitni hogi?
questions.explanation: v_circ = √(GM/r) aur v_esc = √(2GM/r), to v_esc = √2 × 7.5 = 10.6 km/s. 15.0 km/s √2 ki jagah 2 se multiply karne se aata hai. 11.2 km/s Earth ki surface wali escape speed hai jo ratta maari hoti hai — wo is radius ke liye nahi hai.

questions.question: Ek satellite ke elliptical orbit ka perigee 6800 km aur apogee 12000 km hai (dono Earth ke centre se). Perigee par speed kitni hai? (GM = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s²)
questions.explanation: a = (6800 + 12000)/2 = 9400 km. Vis-viva: v_p² = GM(2/r_p − 1/a) = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ × (2/6.8 × 10⁶ − 1/9.4 × 10⁶) = 7.483 × 10⁷, to v_p = 8650 m/s ≈ 8.65 km/s. 7.66 km/s 6800 km par circular speed hai — ellipse ke perigee par speed usse zyada hoti hai. 9.17 km/s formula me a ki jagah r_a daalne se aata hai, aur 10.8 km/s escape speed hai.

questions.question: Elliptical orbit me satellite ki speed kis point par sabse zyada hoti hai?
options: Dono ke beech, semi-minor axis par
questions.explanation: h = r·v⊥ constant hai, to jahan r sabse chhota (perigee) wahan speed sabse zyada. Kepler ka second law bhi yahi kehta hai: paas wale hisse me barabar time me barabar area sweep karne ke liye tez chalna padta hai. Same speed sirf circular orbit me hoti hai, aur apogee par to speed sabse kam hoti hai.

questions.question: Ek satellite ke orbit ka perigee radius 7000 km aur apogee radius 15000 km hai (dono Earth ke centre se). Semi-major axis a kitna hai?
questions.explanation: a = (r_p + r_a)/2 = (7000 + 15000)/2 = 11000 km. 4000 km difference ka half hai. 22000 km sum hai, half karna bhool kar. 10247 km geometric mean √(r_p·r_a) hai, jo semi-minor axis b deta hai, a nahi.

questions.question: Ek satellite Earth ki surface se 600 km upar circular orbit me hai (Earth radius 6371 km). Orbit ki equations me r kitna lena chahiye?
questions.explanation: r hamesha Earth ke centre se naapa jaata hai: r = R + h = 6371 + 600 = 6971 km. 600 km sirf altitude hai — sabse common trap. 5771 km, R − h hai, aur 12742 km Earth ka diameter.

questions.question: 7000 km radius (Earth ke centre se) wale circular orbit ka period kitna hai? (GM = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s²)
questions.explanation: T = 2π√(r³/GM) = 2π√((7 × 10⁶)³/3.986 × 10¹⁴) = 2π × 927.6 = 5828 s = 97.1 min. 15.5 min 2π bhool jaane (927.6 s) se aata hai. 48.6 min 2π ki jagah π lene se, aur 194 min 4π lene se.

questions.question: 500 kg ka satellite 7000 km radius (Earth ke centre se) wale circular orbit me hai. Uski total mechanical energy kitni hai? (GM = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s²)
questions.explanation: E = −GMm/(2a), aur circular orbit me a = r: E = −3.986 × 10¹⁴ × 500/(2 × 7 × 10⁶) = −1.42 × 10¹⁰ J. −2.85 × 10¹⁰ J sirf potential energy (−GMm/r) hai, 2 bhool kar. Positive value kinetic energy ki hai — bound orbit ki total energy hamesha negative hoti hai. −7.12 × 10⁹ J me 2 do baar lag gaya.

questions.question: Ek satellite ka perigee radius 6800 km aur apogee radius 12000 km hai (Earth ke centre se). Apogee par uski speed kitni hai? (GM = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s²)
questions.explanation: a = (6800 + 12000)/2 = 9400 km. Vis-viva: v_a² = GM(2/r_a − 1/a) = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ × (2/1.2 × 10⁷ − 1/9.4 × 10⁶) = 2.40 × 10⁷, to v_a = 4.90 km/s. (Check: v_p = 8.65 km/s, aur 6800 × 8.65 ≈ 12000 × 4.90 ✓.) 5.76 km/s 12000 km par circular speed hai — apogee par ellipse ki speed usse kam hoti hai. 15.3 km/s angular momentum ka ratio ulta lagane se aata hai, aur 6.51 km/s r = a par circular speed hai.

questions.question: Geostationary satellite ka period 1 sidereal day = 86164 s hai. Uski altitude (Earth ki surface se) lagbhag kitni hai? (GM = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s², Earth radius 6371 km)
questions.explanation: T = 2π√(r³/GM) ⇒ r = (GM·T²/4π²)^(1/3) = (3.986 × 10¹⁴ × 86164²/39.48)^(1/3) = 4.216 × 10⁷ m ≈ 42,200 km. Altitude = r − R = 42,164 − 6371 ≈ 35,800 km. 42,200 km orbit ka radius hai, altitude nahi (R ghatana bhool kar). 26,600 km 12 ghante wale orbit ka radius hai (T ko half lene se). 6,400 km to bas Earth ka radius hai.

questions.question: Ek satellite 6771 km radius ke circular LEO se 42164 km radius ke geostationary orbit me Hohmann transfer se jaana chahta hai. LEO par pehla burn (Δv₁) kitna hoga? (GM = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s²)
questions.explanation: Transfer ellipse: r_p = 6771 km, r_a = 42164 km, to a = 24467.5 km. LEO speed v₁ = √(GM/r₁) = 7.67 km/s. Ellipse ki perigee speed (vis-viva) = √(GM(2/r₁ − 1/a)) = 10.07 km/s. Δv₁ = 10.07 − 7.67 = 2.40 km/s. 10.07 km/s poori perigee speed hai, change nahi. 4.60 km/s dono circular speeds ka difference hai — Hohmann me aisa ek burn nahi hota. 3.07 km/s GEO ki circular speed hai.

questions.question: Ek satellite 7000 km radius (Earth ke centre se) wale circular orbit me hai. Usi point se Earth ki gravity se escape karne ke liye speed me kitna extra (tangential) increase chahiye? (GM = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s²)
questions.explanation: v_c = √(GM/r) = √(3.986 × 10¹⁴/7 × 10⁶) = 7.55 km/s. v_esc = √2 × v_c = 10.67 km/s. Extra Δv = 10.67 − 7.55 = 3.13 km/s (= (√2 − 1)v_c). 10.7 km/s poori escape speed hai, increase nahi. 11.2 km/s surface wala ratta value hai, is r ke liye nahi. 7.55 km/s sirf circular speed hai.

weeks.title: Rigid body kinematics and rotating frames
weeks.summary: Is week aap rigid body ki translation, fixed-axis rotation aur general plane motion ki velocity/acceleration nikalna, instantaneous centre use karna, aur rotating axes me Coriolis acceleration samajhna seekhoge.
concepts: **Translation**: body ka har point same velocity aur same acceleration se chalta hai, body ghoomti nahi (ω = 0). Curvilinear translation me bhi line segments apne aap ke parallel rehte hain, jaise Ferris wheel ki seat.

**Fixed-axis rotation**: ω = dθ/dt, α = dω/dt. Axis se r distance wale point ke liye v = ω·r, a_t = α·r (path ke along), a_n = ω²·r (axis ki taraf). Constant α par particle wali equations hi: ω = ω₀ + αt, θ = ω₀t + ½αt², ω² = ω₀² + 2αθ.

**General plane motion (relative velocity)**: v_B = v_A + ω × r_B/A. 2D me ω × r ka magnitude ω·|r_B/A| aur direction r_B/A ke perpendicular (rotation ke sense me). Isse ek point ki velocity aur ω se doosre point ki velocity milti hai.

**Instantaneous centre (IC) of zero velocity**: us pal body ek point ke about pure rotation kar rahi hoti hai. Do points ki velocity directions ke perpendiculars jahan milte hain wahi IC. Phir har point ki speed = ω × (IC se distance). Rolling wheel ka IC zameen wala contact point hai.
**Rolling without slipping**: v_centre = ω·R aur a_centre = α·R. Contact point ki velocity zero, top point ki 2v. Par contact point ki acceleration zero nahi hoti — usme ω²R upar ki taraf hota hai.
**Relative acceleration**: a_B = a_A + α × r_B/A − ω²·r_B/A. Pehla extra term tangential (r ke perpendicular), doosra normal (B se A ki taraf).

**Rotating axes aur Coriolis**: agar point P ek rotating frame (angular velocity Ω) ke andar move kar raha hai: v_P = v_O + Ω × r + v_rel aur a_P = a_O + Ω̇ × r + Ω × (Ω × r) + 2Ω × v_rel + a_rel. 2Ω × v_rel **Coriolis acceleration** hai: ye tabhi aata hai jab frame ghoom raha ho AUR point frame ke andar move kar raha ho.

example.problem: 2.5 m lambi seedhi AB ka top A smooth vertical wall par aur bottom B smooth floor par slide kar raha hai. Jab A floor se 2 m upar hai (to B wall se 1.5 m door hai), B wall se door 1.2 m/s se ja raha hai. Seedhi ki angular velocity aur A ki velocity nikalo.
steps: Wall ko y-axis aur floor ko x-axis lo. A = (0, 2), B = (1.5, 0).
v_A vertical hai, to uska perpendicular A se horizontal line y = 2. v_B horizontal hai, to uska perpendicular B se vertical line x = 1.5.
Dono lines (1.5, 2) par milti hain — yahi IC hai.
IC se B ki distance = 2 m (vertical). ω = v_B/2 = 1.2/2 = 0.6 rad/s.
IC se A ki distance = 1.5 m. v_A = ω × 1.5 = 0.9 m/s, neeche ki taraf.
Check (constraint se): x² + y² = 2.5², to x·ẋ + y·ẏ = 0 ⇒ ẏ = −1.5 × 1.2/2 = −0.9 m/s ✓.
Answer: **ω = 0.6 rad/s, v_A = 0.9 m/s neeche**.

mistakes: Rolling wheel ke har point ki speed v maan lena. Sirf centre ki speed v hai; top 2v, contact point 0, aur baaki points IC se distance ke hisaab se.
IC ko zero acceleration wala point samajhna. IC par sirf velocity zero hoti hai us pal; uski acceleration aam taur par zero nahi.
Rotating frame me Coriolis term (2Ω × v_rel) bhool jaana, ya uska factor 2 chhod dena. Jab point frame ke andar move kare, ye term zaroori hai.
revision: Rotation: v = ωr, a_t = αr, a_n = ω²r.
v_B = v_A + ω × r_B/A.
IC: velocity perpendiculars ka intersection; v = ω × distance.
Rolling: v = ωR, top = 2v, contact = 0.
a = a_O + Ω̇×r + Ω×(Ω×r) + 2Ω×v_rel + a_rel.

questions.question: 0.3 m radius ka wheel bina slip kiye roll kar raha hai aur uske centre ki speed 6 m/s hai. Wheel ke sabse upar wale point ki speed kya hai?
questions.explanation: IC contact point par hai. ω = v/R = 6/0.3 = 20 rad/s. Top point IC se 2R = 0.6 m door hai, to v = 20 × 0.6 = 12 m/s (= 2 × centre speed). 6 m/s centre ki speed hai. 0 contact point ki hai. 8.49 m/s (= 6√2) centre ki height wale side point ki speed hai.

questions.question: Ek disc rest se shuru hokar 4 rad/s² ki constant angular acceleration se ghoomti hai. 3 s baad axis se 0.5 m door wale point ki speed kitni hai?
questions.explanation: ω = ω₀ + αt = 0 + 4 × 3 = 12 rad/s. v = ω·r = 12 × 0.5 = 6 m/s. 12 to ω hai (rad/s), speed nahi. 9 m/s tab aata hai jab angle θ = ½·4·3² = 18 rad ko r se multiply kar dete ho — wo arc length (m) hai. 2 m/s α·r hai, jo tangential acceleration (m/s²) hai.

questions.question: 5 m lambi seedhi ka top A vertical wall par aur bottom B floor par slide kar raha hai. Jab A floor se 4 m upar hai aur B wall se 3 m door, B wall se door 2 m/s se ja raha hai. A ki speed kya hai?
questions.explanation: IC (3, 4) par hai. IC se B ki distance 4 m, to ω = 2/4 = 0.5 rad/s. IC se A ki distance 3 m, to v_A = 0.5 × 3 = 1.5 m/s (neeche). Constraint se bhi: x·ẋ + y·ẏ = 0 ⇒ ẏ = −3 × 2/4 = −1.5 ✓. 2.67 m/s ratio ulta lene se (2 × 4/3) aata hai. 0.5 to ω hai.

questions.question: 1 m lambi bar AB is pal horizontal hai, B, A ke right me hai. A ki velocity 3 m/s right ki taraf hai aur bar 2 rad/s se counter-clockwise ghoom rahi hai. B ki speed kya hai?
questions.explanation: v_B = v_A + ω × r_B/A. r_B/A = 1 m right, CCW rotation se ω × r = 2 × 1 = 2 m/s upar. To v_B = (3 right, 2 upar), |v_B| = √(3² + 2²) = 3.61 m/s. 5.00 m/s tab aata hai jab perpendicular vectors ko scalar ki tarah jod dete ho, aur 1.00 m/s ghatane se.

questions.question: Ek disc fixed axis ke about ghoom rahi hai. Is pal ω = 5 rad/s aur α = 10 rad/s². Axis se 0.2 m door wale point ki total acceleration ka magnitude kya hai?
questions.explanation: a_n = ω²r = 25 × 0.2 = 5 m/s² (axis ki taraf), a_t = αr = 10 × 0.2 = 2 m/s². Dono perpendicular hain: |a| = √(5² + 2²) = 5.39 m/s². 7.00 m/s² unhe seedha jodne se aata hai. 5.00 aur 2.00 sirf ek-ek component hain.

questions.question: Ek horizontal disc constant Ω = 2 rad/s se ghoom rahi hai. Disc ke radial slot me ek slider 1 m/s ki constant relative speed se bahar ki taraf chal raha hai. Jab slider centre se 0.5 m par hai, uski absolute acceleration ka magnitude kya hai?
questions.explanation: Ω̇ = 0, a_rel = 0. Centripetal Ω²r = 4 × 0.5 = 2 m/s² (centre ki taraf). Coriolis 2Ω·v_rel = 2 × 2 × 1 = 4 m/s² (radius ke perpendicular). |a| = √(2² + 4²) = 4.47 m/s². 2.00 m/s² Coriolis bhool jaane se aata hai, 2.83 m/s² Coriolis ka factor 2 chhodne se (√(2² + 2²)), aur 6.00 m/s² perpendicular components ko jodne se.

questions.question: Ek pulley 120 rpm se ghoom rahi hai. Axis se 0.25 m door rim ke point ki speed kya hai?
questions.explanation: ω = 120 × 2π/60 = 12.57 rad/s, v = ω·r = 12.57 × 0.25 = 3.14 m/s. 30.0 m/s rpm ko seedha r se multiply karne se aata hai — pehle rad/s me convert karo. 12.6 to ω (rad/s) hai, speed nahi. 0.50 m/s rev/s (2) × r lene se, 2π bhool kar.

questions.question: Ek body curvilinear translation me hai (jaise Ferris wheel ki seat). Kya sahi hai?
options: Har point circle par hai, to ω ≠ 0
Sirf centre of mass ki velocity defined hai
Points ki speed centre se distance ke saath badhti hai
Har point ki velocity same, ω = 0
questions.explanation: Translation me body ghoomti nahi (ω = 0), to har point ki velocity aur acceleration same hoti hai — path curved ho tab bhi. Seat ka har point ek circle par chalta hai, par sab circles same size ke hain aur seat ki lines apne aap ke parallel rehti hain. Distance ke saath speed badhna rotation ka gun hai, translation ka nahi.

questions.question: 0.4 m radius ka wheel bina slip kiye roll kar raha hai, aur centre ki speed 2 m/s hai. Wheel ki angular velocity kitni hai?
questions.explanation: Rolling without slipping: v = ω·R, to ω = 2/0.4 = 5 rad/s. 0.8 rad/s, v × R lene se aata hai. 2.5 rad/s sirf 1/R hai, speed bhool kar. 10 rad/s top point ki speed (2v = 4 m/s) ko R se divide karne se.

questions.question: Ek flywheel 300 rpm se constant deceleration ke saath 10 s me ruk jaata hai. Rukne tak wo kitne revolutions karta hai?
questions.explanation: ω₀ = 300 × 2π/60 = 31.4 rad/s. Constant α par θ = ½(ω₀ + 0)·t = ½ × 31.4 × 10 = 157 rad = 157/(2π) = 25 revolutions. 50 initial speed (5 rev/s) ko poore 10 s tak maan lene se aata hai, average lena bhool kar. 157 radians hai, revolutions nahi. 1500, rpm aur seconds ko mix karne (300 × 10/2) se.

questions.question: 2 m lambi bar AB is pal vertical hai (B, A ke upar). A ki velocity 4 m/s right ki taraf hai aur bar 1.5 rad/s se clockwise ghoom rahi hai. B ki velocity kya hai?
questions.explanation: v_B = v_A + ω × r_B/A. r_B/A = 2 m upar. Clockwise rotation me A ke upar wala point right ki taraf jaata hai: ω·r = 1.5 × 2 = 3 m/s right. v_B = 4 + 3 = 7 m/s right. 1 m/s rotation ko CCW maan lene (4 − 3) se aata hai. 5 m/s dono ko perpendicular maan kar √(4² + 3²) lene se — yahan dono same (horizontal) line me hain. 3 m/s sirf relative hissa hai, aur wo bhi galat direction me.

questions.question: 4 m lambi seedhi ka top A smooth vertical wall par aur bottom B smooth floor par slide kar raha hai. Jab seedhi floor se 30° par hai, B wall se door 1.5 m/s se ja raha hai. A ki speed kya hai?
questions.explanation: A = (0, 4 sin30°) = (0, 2), B = (4 cos30°, 0) = (3.46, 0). IC (3.46, 2) par hai. IC se B ki distance 2 m, to ω = 1.5/2 = 0.75 rad/s. IC se A ki distance 3.46 m, to v_A = 0.75 × 3.46 = 2.60 m/s neeche. Constraint se check: ẏ = −x·ẋ/y = −3.46 × 1.5/2 = −2.60 ✓. 0.87 m/s distances ka ratio ulta lene se. 1.50 m/s dono ends ki speed same maan lene se, aur 3.00 m/s ω nikalte waqt divide ki jagah multiply (1.5 × 2) karne se.

questions.question: 0.5 m radius ka wheel bina slip kiye 3 m/s ki constant speed se roll kar raha hai. Ground wale contact point ki acceleration kya hai?
questions.explanation: ω = v/R = 3/0.5 = 6 rad/s; speed constant hai to α = 0 aur a_centre = 0. Contact point ki acceleration = a_centre + ω²R (centre ki taraf) = 6² × 0.5 = 18 m/s² upar. "0" IC wali sabse badi galti hai — IC par sirf velocity zero hoti hai, acceleration nahi. 6 m/s², ω ko hi acceleration likh dena hai, aur 36 m/s², ω² ko R se multiply karna bhool jaane se.

questions.question: 0.3 m radius ka wheel bina slip kiye roll kar raha hai. Is pal centre ki speed 3 m/s aur centre ki acceleration 2 m/s² (aage ki taraf) hai. Wheel ke sabse upar wale point ki acceleration ka magnitude kya hai?
questions.explanation: ω = 3/0.3 = 10 rad/s, α = 2/0.3 = 6.67 rad/s². Top point (centre se R upar): a = a_G (aage 2) + α·R (aage 2) + ω²R (neeche, centre ki taraf 30). Aage 4, neeche 30: |a| = √(4² + 30²) = 30.3 m/s². 34.0 m/s² perpendicular components ko seedha jodne se aata hai. 4.0 m/s² normal term ω²R bhool jaane se. 60.0 m/s² ω²R me R ki jagah 2R lene se.

questions.question: Ek horizontal disc constant Ω = 3 rad/s se ghoom rahi hai. Uske radial slot me ek slider centre se 0.4 m par hai, 0.8 m/s ki relative speed se bahar ja raha hai, aur uski relative acceleration 0.5 m/s² (bahar) hai. Slider ki absolute acceleration ka magnitude kya hai?
questions.explanation: Radial: a_rel − Ω²r = 0.5 − 9 × 0.4 = −3.1 m/s² (centre ki taraf). Transverse: Coriolis 2Ω·v_rel = 2 × 3 × 0.8 = 4.8 m/s². |a| = √(3.1² + 4.8²) = 5.71 m/s². 3.92 m/s² Coriolis ka factor 2 bhool jaane (2.4) se aata hai. 6.00 m/s² a_rel ko ignore karne (√(3.6² + 4.8²)) se. 6.31 m/s² a_rel ko centre ki taraf (−0.5) maan lene se.

weeks.title: Rigid body kinetics and mass moment of inertia
weeks.summary: Is week aap mass moment of inertia aur parallel axis theorem, ΣM = Iα se angular acceleration, rolling motion, aur rigid body ki kinetic energy se speed nikalna seekhoge — saath me 3D inertia aur section properties ka intro.
concepts: **Mass moment of inertia**: I = ∫r² dm, jahan r = axis se mass element ki perpendicular distance. Ye rotation ke liye 'mass' jaisa hai: jitna zyada I, utna mushkil ghumana. Radius of gyration k: I = m·k².

**Standard results**: slender rod (length L) centre ke about mL²/12, end ke about mL²/3. Solid disc/cylinder apne axis ke about mR²/2. Thin ring/hoop mR². Solid sphere 2mR²/5. Axis kaunsa hai, ye hamesha check karo.

**Parallel axis theorem**: I = I_G + m·d², jahan I_G centre of mass G se guzarne wale parallel axis ke about hai aur d dono axes ke beech ki distance. Jaise rod ka end: mL²/12 + m(L/2)² = mL²/3. Ye sirf G wale axis se shuru karke hi lagta hai.

**Plane motion ki equations**: ΣFx = m·a_Gx, ΣFy = m·a_Gy, ΣM_G = I_G·α. Fixed axis O ke about rotation me seedha ΣM_O = I_O·α bhi likh sakte ho (I_O parallel axis se). Rolling without slipping me a_G = α·R jodna padta hai.

**Angular momentum aur impulse**: H_G = I_G·ω. Agar kisi axis ke about external moment zero ho to H us axis ke about conserve hota hai — jaise skater haath andar khinch kar I kam karti hai to ω badh jaata hai.
**Kinetic energy**: T = ½m·v_G² + ½I_G·ω². Fixed axis rotation me T = ½I_O·ω². Rolling body me T = ½(m + I_G/R²)·v². Work–energy T₁ + U₁→₂ = T₂ week 6 jaisa hi lagta hai, bas rotational KE jod do.

**3D aur sections (intro)**: 3D body ke liye inertia ek tensor hai: Ixx, Iyy, Izz aur products of inertia Ixy, Iyz, Izx. Principal axes par products zero ho jaate hain. Beams ke cross-section ke liye isi tarah area ka second moment I = ∫y² dA hota hai, jaise rectangle (width b, depth h) ka centroidal I = bh³/12, aur perpendicular axis theorem se polar moment J = Ix + Iy.

example.problem: 3 kg ki uniform rod, length 1.2 m, ek end O par smooth pin se judi hai. Rod ko horizontal position se rest se chhoda jaata hai. Chhodte hi rod ki angular acceleration aur pin par vertical reaction nikalo. (g = 9.81 m/s²)
steps: Chhodte pal ω = 0, to G ki koi normal acceleration nahi; sirf tangential a_G = α·(L/2), neeche.
Vertical: mg − R = m·a_G, to R = 3(9.81 − 7.36) = 7.36 N upar.
Interesting: R = mg/4, yaani chhodte pal pin sirf weight ka chautha hissa uthata hai.
Answer: **α = 12.3 rad/s², pin reaction = 7.36 N upar**.

mistakes: Pinned rod me I_G (mL²/12) use karna jabki moment pin O ke about liya hai. Moment O ke about lo to I_O = mL²/3 chahiye.
Parallel axis theorem ko kisi bhi do axes ke beech laga dena. Ek axis zaroor centre of mass se guzarna chahiye.
Rolling body ki KE me sirf ½mv² lena. Rotation ka ½I_Gω² bhi hai; ring me to dono barabar hote hain.
revision: Rod: mL²/12 (centre), mL²/3 (end); disc mR²/2; ring mR²; sphere 2mR²/5.
I = I_G + md² (G se hi shuru).
ΣM_G = I_G·α; fixed axis: ΣM_O = I_O·α.
T = ½mv_G² + ½I_Gω²; rolling: v = ωR.
Rectangle section: I = bh³/12.

questions.question: 4 kg ki solid disc, radius 0.5 m. Uske central axis (disc ke plane ke perpendicular) ke about mass moment of inertia kya hai?
questions.explanation: I = mR²/2 = 4 × 0.25/2 = 0.5 kg·m². 1.0 kg·m² ring ka formula mR² lagane se aata hai — disc me mass centre ke paas bhi hai, isliye I kam hai. 0.25 kg·m² diameter wale axis (mR²/4) ka hai.

questions.question: 2 kg ki slender rod, length 1.5 m. Parallel axis theorem se rod ke ek end se guzarne wale (rod ke perpendicular) axis ke about I nikalo.
questions.explanation: I_G = mL²/12 = 2 × 2.25/12 = 0.375. d = L/2 = 0.75 m, to md² = 2 × 0.5625 = 1.125. I_end = 0.375 + 1.125 = 1.5 kg·m² (= mL²/3 ✓). 0.375 sirf I_G hai aur 1.125 sirf md² — dono ko jodna padta hai.

questions.question: Ek solid cylinder 30° incline par bina slip kiye neeche roll karta hai. Uske centre ki acceleration kya hai? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Rolling body: a = g sinθ/(1 + I_G/(mR²)). Cylinder: I_G/(mR²) = 1/2, to a = (2/3) × 9.81 × 0.5 = 3.27 m/s². 4.91 m/s² frictionless sliding (g sinθ) hai — rotation ki energy bhool kar. 2.45 m/s² ring ka (I/mR² = 1) aur 3.50 m/s² solid sphere ka (2/5) answer hai.

questions.question: 1.5 m lambi uniform rod ek end par smooth pin se judi hai aur horizontal position se rest se chhodi jaati hai. Chhodte pal angular acceleration kya hai? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: ΣM_O = I_O·α: mg(L/2) = (mL²/3)·α, to α = 3g/(2L) = 3 × 9.81/3 = 9.81 rad/s². 39.2 rad/s² tab aata hai jab pin ke about moment ke saath I_G = mL²/12 laga dete ho. 13.1 rad/s² poore mass ko centre par point mass maan kar (I = m(L/2)²) aata hai.

questions.question: 2 kg ka thin ring (hoop) bina slip kiye 3 m/s se roll kar raha hai. Uski total kinetic energy kitni hai?
questions.explanation: Translational ½mv² = ½ × 2 × 9 = 9 J. Rotational ½I_Gω² = ½(mR²)(v/R)² = ½mv² = 9 J. Total = 18 J. 9 J sirf translation hai. 13.5 J disc ka answer (¾mv²) hai — ring ka saara mass rim par hai, isliye rotation ki KE translation jitni hi hai.

questions.question: 1.2 m lambi uniform rod ek end par pinned hai aur horizontal position se rest se chhodi jaati hai. Jab rod vertical (neeche latki hui) position se guzarti hai, uske free end ki speed kya hai? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: G, L/2 = 0.6 m neeche aata hai. Energy: mg(L/2) = ½(mL²/3)ω², to ω = √(3g/L) = √24.5 = 4.95 rad/s. Free end ki speed = ωL = 4.95 × 1.2 = 5.94 m/s. 4.85 m/s (= √(2gL)) end ko free-fall wala point maan kar aata hai, aur 2.97 m/s centre G ki speed hai (ωL/2).

questions.question: 3 kg ka thin ring, radius 0.4 m. Uske central axis (ring ke plane ke perpendicular) ke about mass moment of inertia kya hai?
questions.explanation: Ring ka saara mass rim par, R distance par hai: I = mR² = 3 × 0.16 = 0.48 kg·m². 0.24 kg·m² disc ka formula (mR²/2) hai. 0.192 kg·m² solid sphere ka 2mR²/5 hai. 1.2 kg·m² R ko square karna bhool jaane (3 × 0.4) se aata hai.

questions.question: 10 kg ki body ka kisi axis ke about I = 2.5 kg·m² hai. Us axis ke about radius of gyration k kitna hai?
questions.explanation: I = m·k² ⇒ k = √(I/m) = √0.25 = 0.5 m. 0.25 m square root lena bhoolne se aata hai. 4 m ulta divide (m/I) karne se. 0.158 m mass ko do baar divide karne (√(2.5/100)) se.

questions.question: Ek flywheel ka I = 2 kg·m² hai aur us par 10 N·m ka net torque lagta hai. Angular acceleration kitni hai?
questions.explanation: ΣM = I·α ⇒ α = 10/2 = 5 rad/s². 20 rad/s² torque ko I se multiply karne se aata hai. 0.2 rad/s² ulta divide (I/M) karne se. 10 rad/s² I ko ignore karna hai.

questions.question: 5 kg ka solid sphere, radius 0.2 m. Sphere ki surface ko chhoone wale tangent axis ke about I kya hai?
questions.explanation: I_G = 2mR²/5 = 2 × 5 × 0.04/5 = 0.08 kg·m². Parallel axis, d = R: I = 0.08 + 5 × 0.04 = 0.28 kg·m². 0.08 sirf I_G hai aur 0.20 sirf md² — dono jodne padte hain. 0.30 sphere ke liye disc wala mR²/2 lene se aata hai (0.10 + 0.20).

questions.question: 10 kg ki solid disc, radius 0.3 m, apne central axis ke about 300 rpm se ghoom rahi hai. Iski kinetic energy kitni hai?
questions.explanation: I = mR²/2 = 10 × 0.09/2 = 0.45 kg·m². ω = 300 × 2π/60 = 31.4 rad/s. T = ½Iω² = ½ × 0.45 × 31.4² = 222 J. 444 J ring ka formula (mR²) lene se aata hai. 20250 J rpm ko seedha ω maan lene (½ × 0.45 × 300²) se. 111 J diameter wala I (mR²/4) lene se.

questions.question: Ek pulley solid disc hai (M = 4 kg, R = 0.2 m) aur smooth axle par ghoomti hai. Uske rim par lipti rope se 2 kg ka block latka hai. Chhodne par block ki acceleration kitni hai? (g = 9.81 m/s², rope slip nahi karti)
questions.explanation: Block: mg − T = m·a. Pulley: T·R = (MR²/2)·α aur a = αR, to T = (M/2)·a = 2a. Jodne par 2 × 9.81 = (2 + 2)a, a = 4.91 m/s². 9.81 m/s² pulley ki inertia bhool jaane (free fall) se aata hai. 3.27 m/s² pulley ko ring (I = MR²) maan lene (19.62/6) se. 6.54 m/s² I = MR²/4 lene (19.62/3) se.

questions.question: Disc A (I = 0.5 kg·m²) 10 rad/s se ghoom rahi hai. Usi axis par rest wali disc B (I = 0.3 kg·m²) ko us par gira diya jaata hai aur dono saath ghoomne lagti hain. Is process me kitni kinetic energy lose hoti hai?
questions.explanation: Axis ke about koi external moment nahi, to angular momentum conserve: 0.5 × 10 = 0.8·ω, ω = 6.25 rad/s. KE pehle = ½ × 0.5 × 100 = 25 J, baad me = ½ × 0.8 × 6.25² = 15.6 J. Loss = 9.38 J (discs ke beech friction se heat). 0 J energy conserve maan lene ki galti hai — yahan angular momentum conserve hota hai, KE nahi. 15.6 J final KE hai, loss nahi. 19.4 J ratio ulta lene (ω = 3.75 rad/s) se aata hai.

questions.question: Ek solid sphere 2 m vertical height wale incline par rest se bina slip kiye neeche roll karta hai. Neeche pahunchne par uske centre ki speed kya hai? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: mgh = ½mv² + ½(2mR²/5)(v/R)² = (7/10)mv², to v = √(10gh/7) = √28.0 = 5.29 m/s. 6.26 m/s = √(2gh), rotation ki KE bhool kar (jaise frictionless sliding). 5.11 m/s disc/cylinder ka answer √(4gh/3) hai. 4.43 m/s ring ka √(gh) hai.

questions.question: Ek rectangular beam section: width b = 100 mm, depth h = 200 mm. Base (neeche wale edge) se guzarne wale horizontal axis ke about area moment of inertia kya hai?
questions.explanation: Centroidal I = bh³/12 = 100 × 200³/12 = 6.67 × 10⁷ mm⁴. Area par bhi parallel axis wahi rule hai: d = h/2 = 100 mm, A = 2 × 10⁴ mm², to I = 6.67 × 10⁷ + 2 × 10⁴ × 100² = 2.67 × 10⁸ mm⁴ (= bh³/3). 6.67 × 10⁷ sirf centroidal I hai. 1.67 × 10⁷ b aur h ko swap karne (hb³/12) se aata hai. 8.67 × 10⁸ d = h (200 mm) lene se.

weeks.title: Single-degree-of-freedom vibrations
weeks.summary: Is week aap spring-mass system ki natural frequency, damping ratio aur logarithmic decrement, aur sinusoidal forcing me steady-state amplitude aur resonance nikalna seekhoge.
concepts: **Free undamped vibration**: mass m, spring k. Equilibrium se displacement x ke liye m·ẍ + k·x = 0. Solution x = A sin(ωn·t + φ), jahan natural circular frequency ωn = √(k/m) rad/s, natural frequency fn = ωn/(2π) Hz aur period T = 1/fn.

**Static deflection shortcut**: vertical spring par mass latkane se spring δst = mg/k khinchti hai. Isliye ωn = √(k/m) = √(g/δst). Sirf static deflection naap kar natural frequency mil jaati hai (δst metre me daalo).
**Springs ka combination**: parallel (dono ek saath stretch) me k_eq = k₁ + k₂. Series (ek ke baad ek, force same) me 1/k_eq = 1/k₁ + 1/k₂, to series ka k_eq dono me se chhote se bhi kam hota hai.

**Viscous damping**: m·ẍ + c·ẋ + k·x = 0. Critical damping c_c = 2√(km) = 2mωn, damping ratio ζ = c/c_c. ζ < 1 underdamped (oscillate karte hue decay), ζ = 1 critically damped (sabse jaldi bina oscillation ke rest), ζ > 1 overdamped. Underdamped me damped frequency ωd = ωn√(1 − ζ²).

**Logarithmic decrement**: do lagatar peaks x₁ aur x₂ ke liye δ = ln(x₁/x₂) = 2πζ/√(1 − ζ²). Ulta: ζ = δ/√(4π² + δ²). Chhote ζ ke liye ζ ≈ δ/(2π). Experiment se damping nikaalne ka sabse aasaan tareeka.

**Harmonic forcing**: F₀ sin(ωt) par steady-state amplitude X = (F₀/k)/√((1 − r²)² + (2ζr)²), jahan frequency ratio r = ω/ωn. F₀/k static deflection hai aur X/(F₀/k) magnification factor. Transient response damping se khatam ho jaata hai, steady state bachta hai.

**Resonance**: r = 1 (forcing frequency = natural frequency) par X = F₀/(2ζk) — damping hi amplitude ko limit karta hai; ζ = 0 ho to theory me amplitude infinite. Design me machines ko resonance se door rakhte hain; r > √2 par mount se transmit hone wali force F₀ se kam ho jaati hai (vibration isolation).

example.problem: 50 kg ki machine springs par mounted hai jinka total k = 200 kN/m aur damping ratio ζ = 0.1. Machine me unbalance se 500 N amplitude ki harmonic force 300 rpm par lagti hai. Steady-state vibration amplitude nikalo.
steps: Forcing frequency: ω = 300 × 2π/60 = 31.4 rad/s.
Static deflection F₀/k = 500/200000 = 0.0025 m = 2.5 mm.
X = 2.5/0.760 = 3.29 mm. Magnification factor 3.29/2.5 = 1.32.
Answer: **X ≈ 3.29 mm**; machine resonance se neeche (r < 1) chal rahi hai.

mistakes: ωn (rad/s) aur fn (Hz) ko mix karna. fn = ωn/(2π); question me jo maanga hai wahi do.
Static deflection mm me daal kar √(g/δst) lagana. δst ko metre me convert karo, warna frequency bahut kam aayegi.
Springs ko series me hone par bhi jod dena. Series me reciprocals jodte hain; k_eq hamesha sabse chhoti spring se bhi kam hota hai.
revision: ωn = √(k/m) = √(g/δst); fn = ωn/2π.
Parallel: k₁ + k₂; series: 1/k_eq = 1/k₁ + 1/k₂.
c_c = 2√(km); ζ = c/c_c; ωd = ωn√(1 − ζ²).
δ = ln(x₁/x₂); ζ = δ/√(4π² + δ²).
X = (F₀/k)/√((1 − r²)² + (2ζr)²); resonance: X = F₀/(2ζk).

questions.question: 2 kg ka mass 800 N/m ki spring se juda hai (no damping). Natural frequency fn (Hz me) kya hai?
questions.explanation: ωn = √(k/m) = √(800/2) = √400 = 20 rad/s. fn = ωn/(2π) = 20/6.283 = 3.18 Hz. 20.0 Hz rad/s ko seedha Hz likh dene se aata hai — sabse common trap. 125.7 Hz 2π se divide ki jagah multiply karne se aata hai.

questions.question: Do springs, k₁ = 300 N/m aur k₂ = 600 N/m, series me (ek ke neeche doosri) judi hain aur unke neeche mass latka hai. Equivalent stiffness kya hai?
questions.explanation: Series: 1/k_eq = 1/300 + 1/600 = 3/600, to k_eq = 200 N/m (= k₁k₂/(k₁ + k₂) = 180000/900). 900 N/m parallel ka formula hai. Series ka k_eq hamesha chhoti spring (300) se bhi kam hota hai, isliye 300 aur 450 bhi galat hain.

questions.question: Ek machine ko uske spring mounts par rakhne se mounts 2.5 mm compress hote hain. System ki natural frequency kya hai? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: ωn = √(g/δst) = √(9.81/0.0025) = √3924 = 62.6 rad/s. fn = 62.6/(2π) = 9.97 Hz. 62.6 Hz rad/s ko Hz likhne se aata hai. 0.315 Hz aur 1.98 Hz δst ko metre me convert na karke 2.5 daal dene se aate hain.

questions.question: Ek system me m = 4 kg, k = 1600 N/m aur damping coefficient c = 40 N·s/m hai. Damping ratio ζ kya hai?
questions.explanation: c_c = 2√(km) = 2√(1600 × 4) = 2 × 80 = 160 N·s/m. ζ = c/c_c = 40/160 = 0.25 (underdamped). 0.5 tab aata hai jab c_c me 2 bhool kar c/√(km) = 40/80 lete ho. 0.025 c/k (= 40/1600) hai, jo dimensionally bhi galat hai.

questions.question: Ek damped free vibration record me do lagatar peaks ki amplitude 10 mm aur 6 mm hai. Damping ratio ζ kitna hai?
questions.explanation: δ = ln(10/6) = 0.511. ζ = δ/√(4π² + δ²) = 0.511/√(39.48 + 0.26) = 0.081 (chhote ζ ke liye δ/2π bhi ≈ 0.081 deta hai). 0.511 to δ hai, ζ nahi. 0.40 amplitude ke percentage drop (4/10) ko ζ maan lene se aata hai. 0.163 = δ/π, yaani 2π ki jagah π.

questions.question: m = 10 kg, k = 4000 N/m, c = 40 N·s/m wale system par F(t) = 20 sin(20t) N ki force lagti hai. Steady-state amplitude kitna hai?
questions.explanation: ωn = √(4000/10) = 20 rad/s = ω, to r = 1 (resonance). ζ = 40/(2√(4000 × 10)) = 40/400 = 0.1. X = (F₀/k)/(2ζ) = (20/4000)/0.2 = 0.025 m = 25 mm. 5 mm sirf static deflection F₀/k hai. Infinite amplitude sirf zero damping par hota — yahan ζ = 0.1 amplitude ko 5 guna par rok deta hai. 50 mm 2ζ ki jagah ζ se divide karne se aata hai.

questions.question: 5 kg ka mass 2000 N/m ki spring par hai (no damping). Natural circular frequency ωn kya hai?
questions.explanation: ωn = √(k/m) = √(2000/5) = √400 = 20 rad/s. 400 square root bhool jaane se aata hai. 3.18 to fn (Hz me) ki value hai (20/2π), ωn ki nahi. 0.05 ulta formula √(m/k) hai.

questions.question: Do springs, k₁ = 300 N/m aur k₂ = 500 N/m, parallel me ek mass ko support karti hain (dono ek saath stretch hoti hain). Equivalent stiffness kya hai?
questions.explanation: Parallel me dono springs same stretch par force deti hain, to k_eq = 300 + 500 = 800 N/m. 187.5 N/m series wala formula (300 × 500/800) hai. 400 N/m average hai, aur 200 N/m difference — dono ka koi physical matlab nahi.

questions.question: Damped system me damping ratio ζ = 1 ho to free vibration kaisi hogi?
options: Bina oscillation ke, par bahut dheere rest
Bina oscillation ke, sabse jaldi rest
questions.explanation: ζ = 1 critical damping hai: system oscillate nahi karta aur sabse kam time me equilibrium par aata hai. Oscillate karte hue decay ζ < 1 (underdamped) ka behaviour hai, aur bina oscillation ke dheere rest par aana ζ > 1 (overdamped) ka. Free damped vibration me amplitude kabhi nahi badhta.

questions.question: Ek system ka ωn = 30 rad/s aur damping ratio ζ = 0.2 hai. Damped natural frequency ωd kitni hai?
questions.explanation: ωd = ωn√(1 − ζ²) = 30√(1 − 0.04) = 30 × 0.980 = 29.4 rad/s. 24.0 rad/s, ζ² ki jagah ζ ghatane (30 × 0.8) se aata hai. 28.8 rad/s square root bhool jaane (30 × 0.96) se. 30.6 rad/s plus lagane se — damping frequency ko kabhi badhata nahi.

questions.question: 8 kg ka mass 3200 N/m ki spring par oscillate karta hai (no damping). Oscillation ka period T kitna hai?
questions.explanation: ωn = √(3200/8) = 20 rad/s. T = 2π/ωn = 0.314 s. 0.050 s, 1/ωn hai, 2π bhool kar. 3.18 s frequency fn (Hz) ko hi period likh dene se aata hai. 0.157 s, 2π ki jagah π lene se.

questions.question: m = 20 kg, k = 8000 N/m aur ζ = 0.2 wale system par F(t) = 100 sin(30t) N ki force lagti hai. Steady-state amplitude kitna hai?
questions.explanation: ωn = √(8000/20) = 20 rad/s, r = 30/20 = 1.5, r² = 2.25. F₀/k = 100/8000 = 12.5 mm. Denominator = √((1 − 2.25)² + (2 × 0.2 × 1.5)²) = √(1.5625 + 0.36) = 1.387. X = 12.5/1.387 = 9.02 mm. 12.5 mm sirf static deflection hai. 10.0 mm damping term ignore karne (12.5/1.25) se aata hai. 5.56 mm "1 −" bhool kar sirf r² se divide karne se.

questions.question: Ek damped vibration record me amplitude 20 mm se shuru hokar 4 cycles baad 5 mm reh jaata hai. Damping ratio ζ kitna hai?
questions.explanation: n cycles ke liye δ = (1/n)·ln(x₀/xₙ) = ln(4)/4 = 0.347. ζ = δ/√(4π² + δ²) = 0.347/√(39.48 + 0.12) = 0.055. 0.221 tab aata hai jab 4 cycles se divide karna bhool jaate ho (ln4/2π). 0.347 to δ hai, ζ nahi. 0.028, 2π ki jagah 4π se divide karne se.

questions.question: m = 5 kg, k = 5000 N/m aur c = 50 N·s/m wale system par 30 N amplitude ki harmonic force theek natural frequency par lagti hai. Steady-state amplitude kitna hai?
questions.explanation: c_c = 2√(km) = 2√25000 = 316.2 N·s/m, to ζ = 50/316.2 = 0.158. Resonance (r = 1) par X = F₀/(2ζk) = 30/(2 × 0.158 × 5000) = 0.0190 m = 19.0 mm. 6.0 mm sirf static deflection F₀/k hai. 37.9 mm, 2ζ ki jagah ζ se divide karne se aata hai. 0.95 mm static deflection ko ζ se multiply kar dene se.

questions.question: Ek machine apne spring mounts par 4 mm static deflection deti hai (damping negligible). Mount se transmit hone wali force F₀ se kam ho (isolation), iske liye machine ki minimum operating speed lagbhag kitni honi chahiye? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
questions.explanation: ωn = √(g/δst) = √(9.81/0.004) = 49.5 rad/s. Isolation ke liye r > √2, to ω > 1.414 × 49.5 = 70.0 rad/s = 70.0 × 60/2π ≈ 669 rpm. 473 rpm sirf natural frequency (r = 1, yaani resonance) hai — wahan to force sabse zyada transmit hoti hai. 70 rpm, rad/s ko hi rpm likh dene se aata hai, aur 946 rpm r > 2 maan lene se.
